title.zh: 卷二百 列傳第八十八 姚鏌 張嵿 伍文定 蔡天祐 詹榮 劉天和 楊守禮 張岳 郭宗臯 趙時春
title.en: Volume 200 Biographies 88: Yao Mo, Zhang 嵿, Wu Wending, Cai Tianyou, Zhan Rong, Liu Tianhe, Yang Shouli, Zhang Yue, Guo Zonggao, Zhao Shichun
title.raw: 卷二百 列傳第八十八 姚鏌 張嵿 伍文定 蔡天祐 詹榮 劉天和 楊守禮 張岳 郭宗臯 趙時春 Volume 200 Biographies 88: Yao Mo, Zhang 嵿, Wu Wending, Cai Tianyou, Zhan Rong, Liu Tianhe, Yang Shouli, Zhang Yue, Guo Zonggao, Zhao Shichun

sentences.zh: 姚鏌 張嵿 伍文定 蔡天祐 詹榮 劉天和 楊守禮 張岳 郭宗臯 趙時春

translations.literal: Yao Mo, Zhang Dian, Wu Wending, Cai Tianyou, Zhan Rong, Liu Tianhe, Yang Shouli, Zhang Yue, Guo Zonggao, Zhao Shichun
translations.idiomatic: Yao Mo, Zhang Dian, Wu Wending, Cai Tianyou, Zhan Rong, Liu Tianhe, Yang Shouli, Zhang Yue, Guo Zonggao, and Zhao Shichun

sentences.zh: 姚鏌，字英之，慈溪人。

translations.literal: Yao Mo, styled Yingzhi, was a man of Cixi.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Mo, styled Yingzhi, was a native of Cixi.

sentences.zh: 弘治六年進士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongzhi he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the sixth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 除禮部主事，進員外郎。

translations.literal: He was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Rites and advanced to assistant department director.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Rites and later promoted to assistant department director.

sentences.zh: 擢廣西提學僉事。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Assistant Education Intendant of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to assistant education intendant of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 立宣成書院，延《五經》師以教士子。

translations.literal: He established Xuancheng Academy and extended teachers of the Five Classics to instruct scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He founded Xuancheng Academy and invited teachers of the Five Classics to instruct students.

sentences.zh: 桂人祀山魈卓旺。

translations.literal: The people of Gui worshipped the mountain spirit Zhuo Wang.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Gui worshipped a mountain spirit called Zhuo Wang.

sentences.zh: 鏌毀像，俗遂變。

translations.literal: Mo destroyed the image, and custom thereupon changed.
translations.idiomatic: Mo destroyed its image, and local custom accordingly changed.

sentences.zh: 遷福建副使，未幾改督學政。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Commissioner of Fujian; before long his duties were changed to supervision of education.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice commissioner of Fujian, and before long was reassigned to supervise educational affairs.

sentences.zh: 正德九年擢貴州按察使。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhengde he was promoted to Surveillance Commissioner of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of the Zhengde reign he was promoted to surveillance commissioner of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十五年拜右副都御史，巡撫延綏。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he received appointment as Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right and Grand Coordinator of Yan-Sui.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was appointed vice censor-in-chief of the right and grand coordinator of Yan-Sui.

sentences.zh: 上邊務六事，皆議行。

translations.literal: He submitted six items on frontier affairs; all were debated and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted six proposals on frontier affairs, all of which were debated and implemented.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年，吉囊入涇陽。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiajing, Jirong entered Jingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Jiajing reign, Jirong invaded Jingyang.

sentences.zh: 鏌遣遊擊彭楧出西路，釋指揮卜雲于獄，使副之。

translations.literal: Mo sent Mobile Corps Commander Peng Zhuan out by the western route, released Commander Bu Yun from prison, and had him serve as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Mo dispatched mobile corps commander Peng Zhuan along the western route, released commander Bu Yun from prison, and had him serve as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 夜半邀擊，斬其二將，乃遁。

translations.literal: At midnight they intercepted and attacked, beheaded two of their generals, and then the enemy fled.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight they ambushed the enemy, beheaded two of their generals, and the raiders then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 璽書褒諭。

translations.literal: An imperial sealed edict commended him.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial edict under seal commended him.

sentences.zh: 尋召為工部右侍郎，出督漕運，改兵部左侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned as Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of Works, sent out to supervise grain transport, and transferred to Vice Minister of the Left in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was summoned to serve as vice minister of the right in the Ministry of Works, sent out to supervise grain transport, and then transferred to vice minister of the left in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 四年，遷右都御史，提督兩廣軍務兼巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to Censor-in-Chief of the Right, with charge over military affairs in the two Guang and concurrent duties as Grand Coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was transferred to censor-in-chief of the right, placed in charge of military affairs in the two Guang provinces, and concurrently appointed grand coordinator.

sentences.zh: 田州土官岑猛謀不軌。

translations.literal: The native official of Tianzhou, Cen Meng, plotted irregular conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Meng, the native official of Tianzhou, plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 鏌調永順、保靖兵，使沈希儀與張經、李璋、張佑、程鑒各統兵八萬，分道討。

translations.literal: Mo mobilized the troops of Yongshun and Baojing, and had Shen Xiyi together with Zhang Jing, Li Zhang, Zhang You, and Cheng Jian each command eighty thousand men to advance on separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Mo mobilized troops from Yongshun and Baojing and placed Shen Xiyi, Zhang Jing, Li Zhang, Zhang You, and Cheng Jian each in command of eighty thousand men to attack along separate routes.

sentences.zh: 而鏌與總兵官硃麒等攻破定羅、丹梁。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Mo, together with Commander-in-Chief Zhu Qi and others, stormed Dingluo and Danliang.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Mo, together with commander-in-chief Zhu Qi and others, captured Dingluo and Danliang.

sentences.zh: 用希儀計，結猛婦翁岑璋使為內應，大破之，斬猛子邦彥。

translations.literal: Using Shen Xiyi's plan, he won over Meng's father-in-law Cen Zhang as an inside collaborator, inflicted a great defeat, and beheaded Meng's son Bangyan.
translations.idiomatic: Following Shen Xiyi's plan, he won over Meng's father-in-law Cen Zhang as an inside collaborator, inflicted a major defeat, and beheaded Meng's son Bangyan.

sentences.zh: 璋誘殺猛，獻其首。

translations.literal: Zhang lured and killed Meng and presented his head.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang lured Meng to his death and presented Meng's head.

sentences.zh: 詔進鏌左都御史，加太子少保，任一子官，諸將進秩有差。

translations.literal: An edict advanced Mo to Left Censor-in-Chief, added Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted one son an office, and promoted the various generals in rank with differences.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promoted Mo to left censor-in-chief, granted him the additional title junior guardian of the heir apparent, appointed one of his sons to office, and advanced the various generals in rank according to merit.

sentences.zh: 鏌請改設流官，陳善後七事，制可。

translations.literal: Mo requested conversion to regular officials and submitted seven measures for post-pacification; the court approved.
translations.idiomatic: Mo requested that the post be converted to regular officials and submitted seven measures for long-term pacification; the court approved.

sentences.zh: 乃命參議汪必東、僉事申惠與參將張經以兵萬人鎮其地。

translations.literal: He then ordered Participating Secretary Wang Bidong, Assistant Surveillance Commissioner Shen Hui, and Assistant Regional Commander Zhang Jing to garrison the place with ten thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered participating secretary Wang Bidong, assistant surveillance commissioner Shen Hui, and assistant regional commander Zhang Jing to garrison the area with ten thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 必東、惠移疾他駐。

translations.literal: Bidong and Hui moved elsewhere on pretext of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bidong and Shen Hui relocated elsewhere on pretext of illness.

sentences.zh: 猛党盧蘇、王受等詐言猛不死，借交阯兵二十萬且至，夷民信之。

translations.literal: Meng's partisans Lu Su and Wang Shou falsely claimed Meng was not dead and that two hundred thousand troops from Jiaozhi were about to arrive; the native people believed it.
translations.idiomatic: Meng's partisans Lu Su and Wang Shou falsely claimed that Meng was still alive and that two hundred thousand troops from Jiaozhi were on their way; the native populace believed them.

sentences.zh: 蘇等薄城，經突圍走，城遂陷。

translations.literal: Su and others pressed the city; Jing broke through and fled, and the city thereupon fell.
translations.idiomatic: Lu and his followers pressed the city; Zhang Jing broke through and fled, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 王受亦攻入思恩府。

translations.literal: Wang Shou also attacked and entered Si'en Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shou also attacked and seized Si'en Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史石金劾鏌失策罔上，並論前總督盛應期。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Shi Jin impeached Mo for failed strategy and deceiving the throne, and also criticized the former Grand Coordinator Sheng Yingqi.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Shi Jin memorialized that Mo's strategy had failed and deceived the throne, and also criticized the former grand coordinator Sheng Yingqi.

sentences.zh: 帝以鏌有功，許便宜撫剿。

translations.literal: The Emperor, considering Mo had merit, permitted him discretionary authority to pacify or suppress.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, considering Mo's merits, allowed him discretionary authority to pacify or suppress as needed.

sentences.zh: 蘇、受數求赦，鏌不許，將大討之。

translations.literal: Su and Shou repeatedly sought pardon; Mo did not permit it and was about to launch a major punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Lu and Wang repeatedly sought pardon, but Mo refused and prepared a major punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 會廷議起王守仁督兩廣軍，令鏌與同事。

translations.literal: At court it was decided to recall Wang Shouren to oversee the armies of the two Guang and ordered Mo to serve jointly with him.
translations.idiomatic: The court decided to recall Wang Shouren to oversee the Guang armies and ordered Mo to serve jointly with him.

sentences.zh: 鏌引疾乞罷，許馳驛歸。

translations.literal: Mo cited illness and requested dismissal; he was permitted to return home by courier relay.
translations.idiomatic: Mo cited illness and requested dismissal; he was permitted to return home by imperial courier relay.

sentences.zh: 初，廣東提學道魏校毀諸寺觀田數千畝，盡入霍韜、方獻夫諸家。

translations.literal: Earlier, Wei Xiao of the Guangdong education circuit had confiscated several thousand mu of temple and monastery land, all of which passed into the households of Huo Tao, Fang Xianfu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Wei Xiao of the Guangdong education circuit had confiscated several thousand mu of temple and monastery land, all of which ended up in the households of Huo Tao, Fang Xianfu, and others.

sentences.zh: 鏌至廣，追還之官。

translations.literal: When Mo arrived in Guang, he pursued recovery and returned the land to the government.
translations.idiomatic: When Mo arrived in Guangdong, he recovered the lands for the government.

sentences.zh: 韜、獻夫恨甚，與張璁、桂萼合排鏌。

translations.literal: Tao and Xianfu hated him deeply and, together with Zhang Cong and Gui E, combined to attack Mo.
translations.idiomatic: Huo and Fang hated him deeply and, together with Zhang Cong and Gui E, combined to attack Mo.

sentences.zh: 謂大同當征而反撫，田州當撫而反征，皆費宏謀國不臧，釀成南北患。

translations.literal: They said Datong should have been suppressed but was instead pacified, and Tianzhou should have been pacified but was instead attacked—all owing to Fei Hong's unsound counsel for the state, which brewed troubles north and south.
translations.idiomatic: They charged that Datong should have been suppressed but was instead pacified, and Tianzhou should have been pacified but was instead attacked—all owing to Fei Hong's unsound statecraft, which had bred troubles north and south.

sentences.zh: 時宏雖去，猶借鏌以排之也。

translations.literal: Though Hong had already left office, they still used Mo to strike at him.
translations.idiomatic: Though Hong had already left office, they still used Mo to strike at him.

sentences.zh: 鏌既得請，方候代，千夫長韋貴、徐伍攻復思恩。

translations.literal: After Mo had obtained his request and was awaiting replacement, company commanders Wei Gui and Xu Wu attacked and recovered Si'en.
translations.idiomatic: After Mo had obtained his dismissal and was awaiting his replacement, company commanders Wei Gui and Xu Wu attacked and recovered Si'en.

sentences.zh: 鏌上其狀。

translations.literal: Mo submitted a report on the situation.
translations.idiomatic: Mo reported their action to the throne.

sentences.zh: 詔先賞貴等，而以撫剿事宜俟守仁處置。

translations.literal: An edict first rewarded Gui and the others, while matters of pacification and suppression were left to Wang Shouren's disposition.
translations.idiomatic: An edict first rewarded Gui and the others, while pacification and suppression were left to Wang Shouren's disposition.

sentences.zh: 既而鏌奏辯石金前疏，詆金阻撓養寇。

translations.literal: Thereafter Mo memorialized in rebuttal to Shi's earlier memorial, denouncing Shi for obstruction and nurturing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Mo then memorialized in rebuttal to Shi's earlier memorial, accusing Shi of obstruction and of nurturing bandits.

sentences.zh: 金亦再疏詆鏌。

translations.literal: Shi also again memorialized denouncing Mo.
translations.idiomatic: Shi again memorialized attacking Mo.

sentences.zh: 帝先入璁等言，落鏌職閑住。

translations.literal: The Emperor, having already accepted Zhang Cong and the others' words, stripped Mo of office and ordered him to live in retirement.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, having already accepted Zhang Cong and the others' words, stripped Mo of office and ordered him to live in retirement.

sentences.zh: 其後，蘇、受復叛，帝漸思鏌。

translations.literal: Afterward, when Su and Shou rebelled again, the Emperor gradually came to miss Mo.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Lu and Wang rebelled again, the emperor gradually came to miss Mo.

sentences.zh: 十三年，三邊闕總制。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the tri-border command was vacant.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the tri-border command was vacant.

sentences.zh: 大學士費宏、李時同召對。

translations.literal: Grand Secretaries Fei Hong and Li Shi were summoned together for audience.
translations.idiomatic: Grand secretaries Fei Hong and Li Shi were summoned together for audience.

sentences.zh: 宏薦鏌，時亦助之。

translations.literal: Hong recommended Mo, and Shi also supported him.
translations.idiomatic: Hong recommended Mo, and Li Shi also supported him.

sentences.zh: 遂命以兵部尚書總制三邊軍務。

translations.literal: He was thereupon ordered as Minister of War to take overall command of tri-border military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Mo was therefore ordered to serve as minister of war with overall command of tri-border military affairs.

sentences.zh: 未赴，宏卒。

translations.literal: Before he could take up the post, Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could take up the post, Hong died.

sentences.zh: 鏌辭。

translations.literal: Mo declined.
translations.idiomatic: Mo declined the appointment.

sentences.zh: 帝不悅，仍落職閑住。

translations.literal: The Emperor was displeased and again stripped him of office for retirement.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was displeased and again stripped him of office for retirement.

sentences.zh: 鏌既罷，薦者至二十疏，不用。

translations.literal: After Mo was dismissed, recommenders submitted as many as twenty memorials, but he was not employed.
translations.idiomatic: After Mo's dismissal, recommenders submitted as many as twenty memorials on his behalf, but he was not employed.

sentences.zh: 家居數年卒。

translations.literal: He lived at home several years and died.
translations.idiomatic: He lived at home for several years and then died.

sentences.zh: 子淶，字維東。

translations.literal: His son Lai, styled Weidong,
translations.idiomatic: His son Lai, styled Weidong,

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年殿試第一。

translations.literal: placed first in the palace examination of the second year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: placed first in the palace examination of the second year of the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 授翰林修撰。

translations.literal: He was appointed Hanlin Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Hanlin compiler.

sentences.zh: 爭「大禮」，廷杖。

translations.literal: He disputed the Great Rites and was beaten at court.
translations.idiomatic: He disputed the Great Rites controversy and was beaten in court.

sentences.zh: 又議郊祀合祀，不當輕易。

translations.literal: He also argued that combining suburban sacrifices should not be done lightly.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued that combining suburban sacrifices should not be done lightly.

sentences.zh: 召修《明倫大典》，懇辭不與。

translations.literal: When summoned to compile the Minglun Dadian, he earnestly declined and did not participate.
translations.idiomatic: When summoned to compile the Minglun Dadian, he earnestly declined and did not participate.

sentences.zh: 累官侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He rose cumulatively to Attendant Reader.
translations.idiomatic: He rose cumulatively to attendant reader.

sentences.zh: 張嵿，字時俊，蕭山人。

translations.literal: Zhang Dian, styled Shijun, was a man of Xiaoshan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dian, styled Shijun, was a native of Xiaoshan.

sentences.zh: 成化二十三年進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Chenghua he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the twenty-third year of the Chenghua reign.

sentences.zh: 弘治初，修《憲宗實錄》，命往蘇、松諸府采軼事。

translations.literal: Early in Hongzhi, while compiling the Veritable Records of Emperor Xianzong, he was ordered to the prefectures of Suzhou and Songjiang to collect anecdotes.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Hongzhi reign, while compiling the Veritable Records of Emperor Xianzong, he was ordered to the prefectures of Suzhou and Songjiang to collect anecdotes.

sentences.zh: 事竣，授上饒知縣。

translations.literal: When the task was finished, he was appointed magistrate of Shangrao.
translations.idiomatic: When the task was finished, he was appointed magistrate of Shangrao.

sentences.zh: 遷南京兵部主事，就進刑部郎中。

translations.literal: He was transferred to principal clerk in the Nanjing Ministry of War and concurrently advanced to director in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to principal clerk in the Nanjing Ministry of War and concurrently promoted to director in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 正德初，遷興化知府。

translations.literal: Early in Zhengde he was transferred to prefect of Xinghua.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhengde reign he was transferred to prefect of Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 隆平侯張祐無子，弟祿與族人爭襲，訴于南京法司，久不決，復訴京師。

translations.literal: Marquis Longping Zhang You had no son; his younger brother Lu contested the succession with clansmen, sued before the Nanjing judiciary, and after long indecision sued again in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Longping Zhang You had no son; his younger brother Lu contested the succession with clansmen, suing before the Nanjing judiciary without resolution for a long time, then suing again in the capital.

sentences.zh: 劉瑾方擅政，遂削尚書樊瑩、都御史高銓籍。

translations.literal: Liu Jin was then monopolizing government and stripped Minister Fan Ying and Censor-in-Chief Gao Quan of their registers.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jin was then monopolizing power and stripped minister Fan Ying and censor-in-chief Gao Quan of their registers.

sentences.zh: 嵿以郎承勘，為民。

translations.literal: Dian, as a director carrying out the investigation, was reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Dian, as the director carrying out the investigation, was reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 瑾敗，起知南雄。

translations.literal: When Jin fell, he was reinstated as prefect of Nanxiong.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin fell, he was reinstated as prefect of Nanxiong.

sentences.zh: 擢江西參政，進右布政使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Administrative Commissioner of Jiangxi and advanced to Right Provincial Administration Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to administrative commissioner of Jiangxi and advanced to right provincial administration commissioner.

sentences.zh: 舉治行卓異，遷左。

translations.literal: Recognized for outstanding governance, he was transferred to the left post.
translations.idiomatic: Recognized for outstanding governance, he was transferred to the left post.

sentences.zh: 甯王宸濠欲拓地，廣其居，嵿執不可。

translations.literal: Prince of Ning Chen Hao wished to expand territory and enlarge his residence; Dian firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Ning Chen Hao wished to expand his territory and enlarge his residence; Dian firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 大恚，遣人饋之。

translations.literal: Greatly enraged, he sent someone to present gifts to him.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly enraged, the prince sent someone to present gifts to him.

sentences.zh: 嵿發視，則棗梨姜芥，蓋隱語也。

translations.literal: When Dian opened them, they were jujubes, pears, ginger, and mustard—a hidden message.
translations.idiomatic: When Dian opened them, they were jujubes, pears, ginger, and mustard—a hidden message meaning he should be beaten and bound.

sentences.zh: 未幾，召為光祿卿。

translations.literal: Before long he was summoned as Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was summoned to serve as director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 以右副都御史巡撫保定諸府，忤中貴，移疾歸。

translations.literal: As Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right he grand-coordinated the prefectures of Baoding and others; he offended the palace eunuchs and retired on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: As vice censor-in-chief of the right he grand-coordinated the prefectures of Baoding and others; he offended the eunuch power-brokers and retired on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 伍文定，字時泰，松滋人。

translations.literal: Wu Wending, styled Shitai, was a man of Songzi.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Wending, styled Shitai, was a native of Songzi.

sentences.zh: 父琇，貴州參議。

translations.literal: His father Xiu was an administrative commissioner of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xiu was an administrative commissioner of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 文定登弘治十二年進士。

translations.literal: Wending passed the jinshi examination in the twelfth year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Wending passed the metropolitan examination in the twelfth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 有膂力，便弓馬，議論慷慨。

translations.literal: He had physical strength, was skilled with bow and horse, and spoke with generous conviction.
translations.idiomatic: He was physically strong, skilled with bow and horse, and spoke with generous conviction.

sentences.zh: 授常州推官，精敏善決獄，稱強吏。

translations.literal: Appointed reviewing official of Changzhou, he was acute and skilled at deciding cases, and was called a formidable magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed reviewing official of Changzhou, he was acute and skilled at deciding cases, and was known as a formidable magistrate.

sentences.zh: 魏國公徐俌與民爭田，文定勘，歸之民。

translations.literal: Duke of Wei Xu Fu contested land with commoners; Wending investigated and returned it to the people.
translations.idiomatic: The duke of Wei, Xu Fu, contested land with commoners; Wending investigated and returned it to the people.

sentences.zh: 劉瑾入俌重賄，興大獄，巡撫艾朴以下十四人悉被逮。

translations.literal: Liu Jin accepted heavy bribes from Fu and launched a major prosecution; Grand Coordinator Ai Pu and fourteen others below him were all arrested.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jin accepted heavy bribes from Fu and launched a major prosecution; grand coordinator Ai Pu and fourteen others below him were all arrested.

sentences.zh: 文定已遷成都同知，亦下詔獄，斥為民。

translations.literal: Wending had already been transferred to subprefect of Chengdu; he too was thrown into the imperial prison and banished as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Wending had already been transferred to subprefect of Chengdu; he too was thrown into the imperial prison and banished as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 瑾敗，起補嘉興。

translations.literal: When Jin fell, he was reinstated at Jiaxing.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin fell, he was reinstated at Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 江西姚源賊王浩八等流劫浙江開化，都御史俞諫檄文定與參將李隆、都指揮江洪、僉事儲珊討之，軍華埠。

translations.literal: Bandits of Yaoyuan in Jiangxi, Wang Haoba and others, raided Kaihua in Zhejiang; Censor-in-Chief Yu Jian ordered Wending, together with Regional Commander Li Long, Regional Commander-in-Chief Jiang Hong, and Surveillance Commissioner Chu Shan, to suppress them; the army encamped at Huabu.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits of Yaoyuan in Jiangxi, Wang Haoba and others, raided Kaihua in Zhejiang; censor-in-chief Yu Jian ordered Wending, together with regional commander Li Long, regional commander-in-chief Jiang Hong, and surveillance commissioner Chu Shan, to suppress them; the army encamped at Huabu.

sentences.zh: 而都指揮白弘與湖州知府黃衷別營馬金。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Regional Commander-in-Chief Bai Hong and the prefect of Huzhou Huang Zhong separately encamped at Majin.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile regional commander-in-chief Bai Hong and the prefect of Huzhou, Huang Zhong, separately encamped at Majin.

sentences.zh: 賊党劉昌三破，執弘，官軍大挫。

translations.literal: The bandit partisan Liu Chang thrice broke them, captured Hong, and the government army suffered a major setback.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit partisan Liu Chang defeated them three times, captured Hong, and the government army suffered a major setback.

sentences.zh: 浩八突華埠，洪、文定擊敗之，追及于孔埠。

translations.literal: Haoba rushed Huabu; Hong and Wending defeated him and pursued as far as Kongbu.
translations.idiomatic: Haoba rushed Huabu; Hong and Wending defeated him and pursued as far as Kongbu.

sentences.zh: 隆、珊亦追至池淮，破其巢，進攻淫田。

translations.literal: Long and Shan also pursued to Chihuai, destroyed their nest, and advanced to attack Yintian.
translations.idiomatic: Long and Shan also pursued to Chihuai, destroyed their nest, and advanced to attack Yintian.

sentences.zh: 洪以奇兵深入，中賊誘，與指揮張琳等皆被執。

translations.literal: Hong led elite troops deep in and fell into an ambush; he and Commander Zhang Lin and others were all captured.
translations.idiomatic: Hong led elite troops deep into enemy territory and fell into an ambush; he and commander Zhang Lin and others were all captured.

sentences.zh: 文定等殿后得還，賊亦遁歸江西。

translations.literal: Wending and others brought up the rear and got back; the bandits also fled to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wending and others brought up the rear and got back safely; the bandits also fled to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 諫等上文定忠勇狀，詔所司獎勞。

translations.literal: Yu and others submitted a memorial on Wending's loyalty and bravery; an edict ordered the relevant office to reward him.
translations.idiomatic: Yu and others submitted a memorial on Wending's loyalty and bravery; an edict ordered the relevant office to reward him.

sentences.zh: 擢河南知府，計擒劇賊張勇、李文簡。

translations.literal: He was promoted to prefect of Henan and through stratagem captured the notorious bandits Zhang Yong and Li Wenjian.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to prefect of Henan and through stratagem captured the notorious bandits Zhang Yong and Li Wenjian.

sentences.zh: 以才任治劇，調吉安。

translations.literal: Because of his ability he was assigned to govern a difficult prefecture and was transferred to Ji'an.
translations.idiomatic: Because of his ability he was assigned to govern a difficult prefecture and was transferred to Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 計平永豐及大茅山賊。

translations.literal: By stratagem he pacified the bandits of Yongfeng and Mount Damao.
translations.idiomatic: By stratagem he pacified the bandits of Yongfeng and Mount Damao.

sentences.zh: 已，佐巡撫王守仁平桶岡、橫水。

translations.literal: Thereafter, he assisted Grand Coordinator Wang Shouren in pacifying Tonggang and Hengshui.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, he assisted Grand Coordinator Wang Shouren in pacifying Tonggang and Hengshui.

sentences.zh: 宸濠反，吉安士民爭亡匿。

translations.literal: When Chen Hao rebelled, the gentry and common people of Ji'an all scrambled to flee and hide.
translations.idiomatic: When Chen Hao rebelled, the gentry and common people of Ji'an scrambled to flee and hide.

sentences.zh: 文定斬亡者一人，眾乃定。

translations.literal: Wending executed one who fled, and the multitude then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Wending executed one man who tried to flee, and the people then settled down.

sentences.zh: 乃迎守仁入城。

translations.literal: He then welcomed Shouren into the city.
translations.idiomatic: He then welcomed Shouren into the city.

sentences.zh: 知府邢珣、徐璉、戴德孺等先後至，共討賊。

translations.literal: The prefects Xing Xun, Xu Lian, Dai Deru, and others arrived one after another and together attacked the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The prefects Xing Xun, Xu Lian, Dai Deru, and others arrived in succession and joined in the campaign against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 文定當大帥。

translations.literal: Wending served as supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: Wending served as supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 丙辰之戰，身犯矢石、火燎須不動。

translations.literal: In the Battle of Bingchen, he personally exposed himself to arrows and stones; when fire singed his beard, he did not stir.
translations.idiomatic: In the Battle of Bingchen, he personally braved arrows and stones; when fire singed his beard, he did not flinch.

sentences.zh: 賊平，功最，擢江西按察使。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified, his merit was greatest, and he was promoted to Regional Inspector of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels were pacified, his merit ranked highest, and he was promoted to regional inspector of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 張忠、許泰至南昌，欲冒其功，而守仁已俘宸濠赴浙江。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhong and Xu Tai arrived at Nanchang, wishing to claim the credit for themselves, but Shouren had already captured Chen Hao and was taking him to Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhong and Xu Tai arrived at Nanchang, hoping to claim the credit for themselves, but Shouren had already captured Chen Hao and was escorting him to Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 忠等失望，大恨。

translations.literal: Zhong and the others were disappointed and deeply resentful.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong and the others were disappointed and filled with bitter resentment.

sentences.zh: 文定出謁，遂縛之。

translations.literal: Wending went out to pay his respects and was thereupon bound.
translations.idiomatic: When Wending went out to pay his respects, they bound him on the spot.

sentences.zh: 文定罵曰：「吾不恤九族，為國家平大賊，何罪？

translations.literal: Wending reviled them, saying: "I care nothing for my nine clans; I pacified a great rebel for the state—what crime is that?
translations.idiomatic: Wending reviled them, saying: "I care nothing for the destruction of my entire clan. I pacified a great rebel for the state—what crime have I committed?

sentences.zh: 汝天子腹心，屈辱忠義，為逆賊報仇，法當斬。

translations.literal: You are the Son of Heaven's intimate confidants, yet you humiliate the loyal and righteous and avenge the rebel traitor—by law you ought to be executed.
translations.idiomatic: You are the Son of Heaven's closest confidants, yet you humiliate loyal men and avenge a rebel traitor. By law you deserve execution.

sentences.zh: 」忠益怒，椎文定僕地。

translations.literal: " Zhong grew even angrier and beat Wending, knocking him to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhong grew even angrier and struck Wending, knocking him to the ground.

sentences.zh: 文定求解任，不報。

translations.literal: Wending requested to be relieved of his post; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: Wending requested to be relieved of his post, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 尋遷廣東右布政使。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to right provincial administration commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 未赴，而世宗嗣位。

translations.literal: Before he took up the post, the Shizong Emperor succeeded to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could take up the post, the Shizong Emperor succeeded to the throne.

sentences.zh: 上忠等罪狀，且曰：「曩忠、泰與劉暉至江西，忠自稱天子弟，暉稱天子兒，泰稱威武副將軍，與天子同僚。

translations.literal: He submitted the crimes of Zhong and the others, and said: "Formerly Zhong, Tai, and Liu Hui came to Jiangxi. Zhong styled himself the Son of Heaven's younger brother; Hui styled himself the Son of Heaven's son; Tai styled himself Deputy General of Military Majesty, equal in rank with the Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted an account of the crimes of Zhong and the others, saying: "When Zhong, Tai, and Liu Hui came to Jiangxi, Zhong styled himself the Son of Heaven's younger brother, Hui styled himself the Son of Heaven's son, and Tai styled himself Deputy General of Military Majesty, putting himself on equal footing with the Son of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 折辱命吏，誣害良民。

translations.literal: They humiliated appointed officials and falsely harmed good common people.
translations.idiomatic: They humiliated appointed officials and falsely persecuted innocent people.

sentences.zh: 需求萬端，漁獵盈百萬。

translations.literal: Their demands were innumerable, and their extortion exceeded a million.
translations.idiomatic: Their demands were endless, and their extortion exceeded a million.

sentences.zh: 致餓殍遍野，盜賊縱橫。

translations.literal: This caused starving corpses to fill the countryside and bandits to run rampant.
translations.idiomatic: The result was starving corpses strewn across the countryside and bandits running rampant.

sentences.zh: 雖寸斬三人，不足謝江西百姓。

translations.literal: Even if the three were cut to pieces, it would not suffice to answer to the people of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Even if the three were executed by dismemberment, it would not be enough to atone to the people of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 今大憝江彬、強尼皆已伏法，三人實其黨與。

translations.literal: Now the great villain Jiang Bin and the monk Qiang Ni have both been executed by law; the three men were in fact their associates.
translations.idiomatic: Now the great villain Jiang Bin and the monk Qiang Ni have both been executed, and these three men were in fact their associates.

sentences.zh: 乞速正天誅，用章國典。

translations.literal: I beg that heavenly punishment be swiftly carried out upon them to manifest the statutes of the state.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that they be swiftly punished according to law, so that the authority of the state may be upheld.

sentences.zh: 」又請發宸濠資財，還之江西，以資經費；

translations.literal: " He also requested that Chen Hao's assets be disbursed and returned to Jiangxi to supply expenses;
translations.idiomatic: " He also requested that Chen Hao's assets be disbursed and returned to Jiangxi to cover expenses;

sentences.zh: 矜釋忠、泰所陷無辜及甯府宗人不預謀者，以清冤獄。

translations.literal: and that the innocent persons framed by Zhong and Tai, and the Princely Ning clansmen who had not taken part in the plot, be shown mercy and released, so as to clear wrongful imprisonments.
translations.idiomatic: and that the innocent people framed by Zhong and Tai, together with Princely Ning clansmen who had not taken part in the plot, be shown mercy and released, so as to clear wrongful cases.

sentences.zh: 帝並嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved and accepted all of this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved and accepted all of these proposals.

sentences.zh: 論功，進右副都御史，提督操江。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed, he was advanced to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right and appointed Superintendent of River Defense.
translations.idiomatic: When merits were assessed, he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief of the right and appointed superintendent of river defense.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三年，討獲海賊董效等二百餘人，賜敕獎勞。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiajing, he captured more than two hundred sea bandits including Dong Xiao, and was granted an imperial edict of reward and commendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiajing, he captured more than two hundred sea bandits including Dong Xiao, and was granted an imperial edict commending his service.

sentences.zh: 尋謝病歸。

translations.literal: Before long he resigned on grounds of illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he resigned on grounds of illness and returned home.

sentences.zh: 六年召拜兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was summoned and appointed Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was summoned and appointed vice minister of the right in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 其冬擢右都御史，代胡世寧掌院事。

translations.literal: That winter he was promoted to Censor-in-Chief of the Right, replacing Hu Shining in presiding over the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he was promoted to censor-in-chief of the right, replacing Hu Shining as head of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 雲南士酋安銓反，敗參政黃昭道，攻陷尋甸、嵩明。

translations.literal: The tribal chieftain An Quan of Yunnan rebelled, defeated Assistant Administrator Huang Zhaodao, and captured Xundian and Songming.
translations.idiomatic: The tribal chieftain An Quan of Yunnan rebelled, defeated assistant administrator Huang Zhaodao, and captured Xundian and Songming.

sentences.zh: 明年，武定土酋鳳朝文亦反，殺同知以下官，與銓合兵圍雲南。

translations.literal: The next year the tribal chieftain Feng Chaowen of Wuding also rebelled, killed officials down to the sub-prefect, and joined forces with Quan to besiege Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the tribal chieftain Feng Chaowen of Wuding also rebelled, killed officials down to the sub-prefect, and joined forces with Quan to besiege Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 詔進文定兵部尚書兼前職，提督雲南、四川、貴州、湖廣軍討之，以侍郎梁材督餉。

translations.literal: An edict advanced Wending to Minister of War while retaining his previous post, and appointed him to supervise the armies of Yunnan, Sichuan, Guizhou, and Huguang to suppress them; Vice Minister Liang Cai was to oversee supplies.
translations.idiomatic: An edict promoted Wending to minister of war while retaining his previous post, and appointed him to supervise the armies of Yunnan, Sichuan, Guizhou, and Huguang in suppressing the rebels; Vice Minister Liang Cai was assigned to oversee supplies.

sentences.zh: 會芒部叛酋沙保子普奴為亂，並以屬文定。

translations.literal: It happened that Pu Nu, son of the rebel chieftain Sha Bao of Mangbu, was also in revolt, and he too was placed under Wending's command.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Pu Nu, son of the rebel chieftain Sha Bao of Mangbu, was also in revolt, and he too was placed under Wending's command.

sentences.zh: 文定未至雲南，銓等已為巡撫歐陽重所破，遂移師征普奴。

translations.literal: Before Wending reached Yunnan, Quan and the others had already been defeated by Grand Coordinator Ouyang Chong, so he shifted his army to campaign against Pu Nu.
translations.idiomatic: Before Wending reached Yunnan, Quan and the others had already been defeated by Grand Coordinator Ouyang Chong, so he shifted his army to campaign against Pu Nu.

sentences.zh: 左都御史李承勳極言川、貴殘破，不當用兵，遂召還，命提督京營。

translations.literal: Left Censor-in-Chief Li Chengxun strongly argued that Sichuan and Guizhou were devastated and that military force should not be used; Wending was thereupon recalled and ordered to supervise the capital garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Left Censor-in-Chief Li Chengxun strongly argued that Sichuan and Guizhou were devastated and that military force should not be used; Wending was thereupon recalled and ordered to supervise the capital garrison.

sentences.zh: 文定至湖廣，疏乞省祭歸。

translations.literal: When Wending reached Huguang, he memorialized requesting leave to return home for provincial sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: When Wending reached Huguang, he memorialized requesting leave to return home for ancestral sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 已，四川巡按御史戴金復上言：「叛酋稱亂之初，勢尚可撫。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, Sichuan Surveillance Censor Dai Jin memorialized again: "At the outset when the rebel chieftain raised disorder, the situation could still have been pacified by appeasement.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly thereafter, Sichuan surveillance censor Dai Jin memorialized again: "When the rebel chieftain first rose in revolt, the situation could still have been settled through appeasement.

sentences.zh: 而文定決意進兵，一無顧惜。

translations.literal: Yet Wending resolved to advance troops and showed not the slightest regard for consequences.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Wending resolved to advance troops and showed no regard for the consequences.

sentences.zh: 飛芻挽糧，糜數十萬。

translations.literal: Forage was rushed forward and grain transported at a gallop, squandering several hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Forage was rushed forward and grain transported at a gallop, squandering several hundred thousand in funds.

sentences.zh: 及有詔罷師，尚不肯已。

translations.literal: Even after an edict ordered the army withdrawn, he still would not stop.
translations.idiomatic: Even after an edict ordered the army withdrawn, he still refused to stop.

sentences.zh: 又極論土酋阿濟等罪。

translations.literal: He also argued at length the crimes of the tribal chieftain Aji and others.
translations.idiomatic: He also argued at length for the guilt of the tribal chieftain Aji and others.

sentences.zh: 軍民訛言，幾復生變。

translations.literal: Among soldiers and civilians false rumors spread, and disorder nearly broke out again.
translations.idiomatic: False rumors spread among soldiers and civilians, and unrest nearly broke out again.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為文定可罪也。

translations.literal: This subject humbly considers that Wending may be held guilty.
translations.idiomatic: In my humble opinion, Wending deserves to be punished.

sentences.zh: 」尚書方獻夫、李承勳因詆文定好大喜功，傷財動眾，乃令致仕。

translations.literal: " Ministers Fang Xianfu and Li Chengxun thereupon denounced Wending for loving grand achievements and wasting resources while mobilizing the masses, and he was ordered to retire.
translations.idiomatic: " Ministers Fang Xianfu and Li Chengxun thereupon denounced Wending for seeking grand achievements at the cost of wasting resources and mobilizing large forces, and he was ordered to retire from office.

sentences.zh: 文定忠義自許，遇事敢為，不與時俯仰。

translations.literal: Wending prided himself on loyalty and righteousness, dared to act when matters arose, and would not bow and scrape with the times.
translations.idiomatic: Wending prided himself on loyalty and righteousness, acted boldly when the occasion demanded, and would not trim his conduct to suit the times.

sentences.zh: 芒部之役，憤小丑數亂，欲為國伸威，為議者旁撓。

translations.literal: In the Mangbu campaign, indignant that petty villains repeatedly caused disorder, he wished to uphold the state's authority, but was sidetracked by critics.
translations.idiomatic: In the Mangbu campaign, indignant that petty rebels repeatedly caused disorder, he wished to uphold the state's authority, but was thwarted by critics who interfered from the side.

sentences.zh: 廟堂專務姑息，以故功不克就。

translations.literal: The court devoted itself solely to indulgence, and for this reason success could not be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: The court devoted itself solely to appeasement, and for this reason his achievements could not be brought to completion.

sentences.zh: 九年七月卒於家。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year he died at home.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，追諡忠襄。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Tianqi reign he was posthumously given the temple name Zhongxiang.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Tianqi reign he was posthumously given the temple name Zhongxiang.

sentences.zh: 邢珣，當塗人，弘治六年進士。

translations.literal: Xing Xun was a man of Dangtu and a jinshi of the sixth year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Xun was a native of Dangtu and passed the metropolitan examination in the sixth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 正德初，曆官南京戶部郎中。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhengde he successively served as a bureau director in the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhengde reign he served as a bureau director in the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 忤劉瑾，除名。

translations.literal: He offended Liu Jin and was struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: He offended Liu Jin and was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 瑾誅，起南京工部，遷贛州知府。

translations.literal: When Jin was executed, he was reappointed to the Nanjing Ministry of Works and transferred to prefect of Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin was executed, he was reappointed to the Nanjing Ministry of Works and later transferred to prefect of Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 招降劇盜滿總等，授廬給田，撫之甚厚。

translations.literal: He induced the notorious bandit Man Zong and others to surrender, granted them dwellings and fields, and treated them very generously.
translations.idiomatic: He induced the notorious bandit Man Zong and others to surrender, granted them dwellings and fields, and treated them with great generosity.

sentences.zh: 後討他盜，多藉其力。

translations.literal: Later, in campaigns against other bandits, he often relied on their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Later, in campaigns against other bandits, he often relied on their help.

sentences.zh: 守仁征橫水、桶岡，珣常為軍鋒。

translations.literal: When Shouren campaigned against Hengshui and Tonggang, Xun often served as the army's vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Shouren campaigned against Hengshui and Tonggang, Xun often served as the army's vanguard.

sentences.zh: 功最，增二秩。

translations.literal: His merit was greatest, and he was raised two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: His merit ranked highest, and he was promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 宸濠反，以重賞誘總。

translations.literal: When Chen Hao rebelled, he tried to lure Zong with rich rewards.
translations.idiomatic: When Chen Hao rebelled, he tried to lure Man Zong with rich rewards.

sentences.zh: 總執其使送珣，遂從珣共平宸濠。

translations.literal: Zong seized Chen Hao's envoy and sent him to Xun, then followed Xun in jointly pacifying Chen Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Zong seized Chen Hao's envoy and delivered him to Xun, then followed Xun in jointly suppressing Chen Hao's rebellion.

sentences.zh: 徐璉，朝邑人。

translations.literal: Xu Lian was a man of Chaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Lian was a native of Chaoyi.

sentences.zh: 文定同年進士。

translations.literal: He was a jinshi of the same year as Wending.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the same year as Wending.

sentences.zh: 由戶部郎中出為袁州知府。

translations.literal: From a bureau director in the Ministry of Revenue he went out to serve as prefect of Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After serving as a bureau director in the Ministry of Revenue, he was appointed prefect of Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 從討宸濠，獲首功千餘。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign against Chen Hao and took more than a thousand heads for merit.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the campaign against Chen Hao and claimed more than a thousand enemy heads for merit.

sentences.zh: 事定，珣、璉遷江西右參政。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Xun and Lian were transferred to Right Assistant Administrator of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, Xun and Lian were transferred to right assistant administrator of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 世宗錄功，各增秩二等。

translations.literal: The Shizong Emperor recorded their merit, and each was raised two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizong Emperor recorded their merits, and each was promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年大計，給事御史劾監司不職者二十二人，珣、璉與焉。

translations.literal: At the grand assessment in the second year of Jiajing, supervising secretaries and censors impeached twenty-two surveillance and administration officials for dereliction of duty; Xun and Lian were among them.
translations.idiomatic: At the grand assessment in the second year of Jiajing, supervising secretaries and censors impeached twenty-two surveillance and administration officials for dereliction of duty; Xun and Lian were among them.

sentences.zh: 吏部以軍功未酬，請進秩布政使致仕，從之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel, on the grounds that their military merit had not been rewarded, requested that they be advanced to provincial administration commissioner and retired; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel, noting that their military merit had not been properly rewarded, requested that they be promoted to provincial administration commissioner and allowed to retire; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 二人竟廢。

translations.literal: The two men were ultimately cast aside.
translations.idiomatic: In the end, both men were cast aside.

sentences.zh: 珣子埴嘗學于張璁。

translations.literal: Xun's son Zhi had once studied under Zhang Cong.
translations.idiomatic: Xun's son Zhi had once studied under Zhang Cong.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖初登鄉薦。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiajing he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jiajing reign he passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 璁貴顯，屢欲援之，辭不應。

translations.literal: When Cong rose to high prominence, he repeatedly wished to support him, but Zhi declined and would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: When Cong rose to high prominence, he repeatedly tried to advance Zhi's career, but Zhi declined.

sentences.zh: 授浦城知縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Pucheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Pucheng.

sentences.zh: 有徐浦者，役公府。

translations.literal: There was a man named Xu Pu who served in the prefectural office.
translations.idiomatic: There was a man named Xu Pu who served in the prefectural office.

sentences.zh: 埴一見異之，令與子同學，為娶妻。

translations.literal: At first sight Zhi regarded him as extraordinary, had him study together with his son, and found him a wife.
translations.idiomatic: At first sight Zhi recognized his exceptional talent, had him study together with his son, and found him a wife.

sentences.zh: 後登第為給事中。

translations.literal: Later he passed the examination and became a supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Later he passed the metropolitan examination and became a supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 其家世世祀埴。

translations.literal: His family for generations made offerings to Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: His family worshipped Zhi in every generation.

sentences.zh: 弟址，進士，曆御史，終山東鹽運使。

translations.literal: His younger brother Zhi was a jinshi, successively served as a censor, and ended as salt transport commissioner of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Zhi was a jinshi, served successively as a censor, and ended his career as salt transport commissioner of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 以清操聞。

translations.literal: He was known for his integrity.
translations.idiomatic: He was known for his integrity.

sentences.zh: 戴德孺，臨海人。

translations.literal: Dai Deru was a man of Linhai.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Deru was a native of Linhai.

sentences.zh: 弘治十八年進士。

translations.literal: He was a jinshi of the eighteenth year of Hongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the eighteenth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 曆工部員外郎。

translations.literal: He successively served as an assistant department director in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He served as an assistant department director in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 監蕪湖稅，有清名。

translations.literal: He supervised the Wuhu tax levy and had a reputation for integrity.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised the Wuhu tax levy and earned a reputation for integrity.

sentences.zh: 再遷臨江知府。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to prefect of Linjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was later transferred to prefect of Linjiang.

sentences.zh: 宸濠反，遣使收府印，德孺斬之。

translations.literal: When Chen Hao rebelled, he sent an envoy to seize the prefectural seal; Deru executed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Chen Hao rebelled, he sent an envoy to seize the prefectural seal; Deru executed the envoy.

sentences.zh: 與家人誓曰：「吾死守孤城。

translations.literal: He swore with his family, saying: "I shall die defending this isolated city.
translations.idiomatic: He swore an oath with his family, saying: "I shall die defending this isolated city.

sentences.zh: 脫有急，若輩沉池中，吾不負國也。

translations.literal: If there is an emergency, you all must drown yourselves in the pool—I will not fail the state.
translations.idiomatic: If danger comes, you must all drown yourselves in the pool. I will not fail the state.

sentences.zh: 」即日戒嚴。

translations.literal: " That same day he imposed martial law.
translations.idiomatic: " That same day he imposed martial law.

sentences.zh: 旋與守仁共滅宸濠。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he joined Shouren in jointly destroying Chen Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly thereafter he joined Shouren in suppressing Chen Hao's rebellion.

sentences.zh: 以憂去。

translations.literal: He left office on grounds of grief.
translations.idiomatic: He left office on grounds of grief.

sentences.zh: 世宗以德孺馭軍最整，獨增三秩，為雲南右布政使。

translations.literal: The Shizong Emperor, because Deru had commanded troops with the greatest discipline, alone raised him three ranks and appointed him Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: The Shizong Emperor, noting that Deru had commanded troops with the greatest discipline, alone promoted him three ranks and appointed him right provincial administration commissioner of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 舟次徐州，覆水死。

translations.literal: When his boat stopped at Xuzhou, he capsized in the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: When his boat stopped at Xuzhou, it capsized and he drowned.

sentences.zh: 後贈光祿寺卿，予一子官。

translations.literal: Later he was posthumously granted the title Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and one son was granted an official post.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was posthumously granted the title director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, and one son was granted an official post.

sentences.zh: 珣、璉等倡義討賊，月余成大功。

translations.literal: Xun, Lian, and the others took the lead in righteousness to attack the rebels, and in little more than a month achieved great success.
translations.idiomatic: Xun, Lian, and the others took the lead in rallying the righteous cause against the rebels, and in little more than a month achieved a great victory.

sentences.zh: 當事者以嫉守仁故，痛裁抑之。

translations.literal: Those in power, because they envied Shouren, severely curtailed and suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: Those in power, envying Shouren, severely curtailed and suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 或賞或否，又往往借考功法逐之去。

translations.literal: Some were rewarded and some were not; moreover they were often driven away by exploiting the merit-assessment regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Some were rewarded and some were not; moreover they were often driven from office by exploiting the merit-assessment regulations.

sentences.zh: 守仁之再疏辭爵也，為諸人訟曰：

translations.literal: When Shouren twice memorialized declining enfeoffment, he pleaded on behalf of these men, saying:
translations.idiomatic: When Shouren twice memorialized declining enfeoffment, he pleaded on behalf of these men, saying:

sentences.zh: 宸濠變初起，勢焰猖熾，人心疑懼退阻。

translations.literal: When Chen Hao's rebellion first broke out, its momentum was wildly fierce, and people's hearts were doubtful, fearful, and inclined to retreat and hold back.
translations.idiomatic: When Chen Hao's rebellion first broke out, its momentum was wildly fierce, and people's hearts were filled with doubt and fear, inclined to retreat and hold back.

sentences.zh: 當時首從義師，自伍文定、邢珣、徐璉、戴德孺諸人外，又有知府陳槐、曾璵、胡堯元等，知縣劉源清、馬津、傅南喬、李美、李楫及楊材、王冕、顧佖、劉守緒、王軾等，鄉官都御史王懋中，編修鄒守益，御史張鰲山、伍希儒、謝源等。

translations.literal: At that time those who first followed the righteous army, apart from Wu Wending, Xing Xun, Xu Lian, Dai Deru and the like, also included Prefect Chen Huai, Zeng Yu, Hu Yaoyuan and others; Magistrates Liu Yuanqing, Ma Jin, Fu Nanqiao, Li Mei, Li Ji, as well as Yang Cai, Wang Mian, Gu Yi, Liu Shouxu, Wang Shi and others; local official Censor-in-Chief Wang Maozhong; Compiler Zou Shouyi; and Censors Zhang Aoshan, Wu Xiru, Xie Yuan and others.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, those who were first to join the righteous army included, besides Wu Wending, Xing Xun, Xu Lian, Dai Deru, and others, the prefects Chen Huai, Zeng Yu, and Hu Yaoyuan; the magistrates Liu Yuanqing, Ma Jin, Fu Nanqiao, Li Mei, and Li Ji, along with Yang Cai, Wang Mian, Gu Yi, Liu Shouxu, and Wang Shi; the local official censor-in-chief Wang Maozhong; the compiler Zou Shouyi; and the censors Zhang Aoshan, Wu Xiru, and Xie Yuan.

sentences.zh: 或摧鋒陷陣，或遮邀伏擊，或贊畫謀議，監錄經紀，所謂同功一體者也。

translations.literal: Some smashed through enemy lines and broke into formations; some lay in ambush to intercept and strike from concealment; some assisted in planning and counsel, and oversaw records and logistics—they were what is called sharing merit as one body.
translations.idiomatic: Some smashed through enemy lines; others laid ambushes; still others advised on strategy and managed records and logistics—they were, as the saying goes, partners in a single achievement.

sentences.zh: 帳下之士，若聽選官雷濟，已故義官蕭禹，致仕縣丞龍光，指揮高睿，千戶王佐等，或詐為兵檄以撓其進止，壞其事機，或偽書反間以離其心腹，散其黨與。

translations.literal: Among the men under his command, such as Clerk-of-Selection Lei Ji, the deceased honorary official Xiao Yu, retired assistant magistrate Long Guang, commander Gao Rui, centurion Wang Zuo and others—some feigned military orders to disrupt the enemy's movements and spoil their opportunities, while others forged letters as counter-intelligence to alienate their trusted lieutenants and scatter their followers.
translations.idiomatic: Among the men in his command—Clerk-of-Selection Lei Ji, the late honorary official Xiao Yu, retired assistant magistrate Long Guang, commander Gao Rui, centurion Wang Zuo, and others—some forged military orders to disrupt the enemy's movements and ruin their plans, while others sent forged letters to sow discord among their inner circle and break up their faction.

sentences.zh: 今聞紀功文冊，改造者多所刪削。

translations.literal: It is now heard that in the merit records and official registers, those who revised them have deleted much.
translations.idiomatic: I have now learned that in the records of merit, those who revised them have cut away much.

sentences.zh: 舉人冀元亨為臣勸說甯王，反為奸人構陷，竟死獄中，尤傷心慘目，負之冥冥之中者。

translations.literal: The presented scholar Ji Yuanheng, who on my behalf urged the Prince of Ning, was instead framed by wicked men and eventually died in prison—especially heartbreaking and grievous to behold; I bear this debt to him in the hidden realm beyond.
translations.idiomatic: The presented scholar Ji Yuanheng, who on my behalf had tried to persuade the Prince of Ning, was instead framed by wicked men and died in prison—a sight especially heartbreaking to behold; I owe him a debt in the world beyond.

sentences.zh: 夫宸濠積威淩劫，雖在數千里外，無不震駭失措。

translations.literal: Chen Hao's accumulated power and intimidation—even thousands of li away, none failed to be shaken, terrified, and thrown into confusion.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Hao's long-standing prestige and intimidation were such that even thousands of li away, no one failed to be shaken with terror and thrown into confusion.

sentences.zh: 而況江西諸郡縣切近剝床，觸目皆賊兵，隨處有賊黨，非真有捐軀赴難之義，戮力報主之忠，孰肯甘齏粉之禍，從赤族之誅，蹈必死之地，以希萬一難冀之功乎！

translations.literal: How much more so the prefectures and counties of Jiangxi, pressed close as if the bedframe were being stripped away—rebel soldiers met the eye everywhere, rebel partisans lurked in every place. Unless one truly possessed the righteousness of sacrificing oneself to meet calamity and the loyalty of striving with full force to repay one's lord, who would willingly accept the disaster of being ground to powder, submit to execution extending to one's entire clan, tread ground where death was certain, all in hopes of a success that was hard to expect even one chance in ten thousand?
translations.idiomatic: How much more so in Jiangxi's prefectures and counties, pressed hard on every side—rebel soldiers wherever one looked, rebel sympathizers at every turn. Without genuine willingness to sacrifice one's life in crisis and to serve the throne with every ounce of one's strength, who would willingly face being ground to dust, bring down extermination on one's entire clan, and march into certain death—all for the slimmest chance of success?

sentences.zh: 今臣獨崇封爵，而此同事諸人者，或賞不行而並削其績，或賞未及而罰已先行，或虛受升職之名而因使退閑，或冒蒙不忠之號而隨以廢斥。

translations.literal: Now I alone have been raised in ennoblement and rank, while these colleagues—some received no reward and even had their merit erased; some had punishment fall before reward reached them; some bore empty titles of promotion only to be sidelined into retirement; some were falsely labeled disloyal and then promptly dismissed and cast out.
translations.idiomatic: Now I alone have been raised in rank and ennobled, while these colleagues of mine—some received no reward and even had their accomplishments erased; some were punished before any reward could reach them; some received nominal promotions only to be pushed into retirement; some were falsely branded disloyal and then cast out.

sentences.zh: 非獨為已斥諸權奸所誣構挫辱而已也。

translations.literal: It was not only that they had already been slandered and framed by the ousted powerful villains and humiliated.
translations.idiomatic: And this was not merely because they had already been slandered and framed by the ousted power brokers and brought to shame.

sentences.zh: 群憎眾嫉，惟事指摘搜羅以為快，曾未見有鳴其不平、伸其屈抑者，臣竊痛之。

translations.literal: Collective hatred and widespread envy—people took pleasure only in pointing fingers, searching out faults, and gathering evidence; never did one see anyone speak out against the injustice or plead their suppressed grievances—I secretly grieve for this.
translations.idiomatic: Hatred and envy were everywhere; people took their pleasure in picking faults and digging up offenses, and I never saw anyone speak up for their grievances or defend what had been done to them—I grieve for this in my heart.

sentences.zh: 奏入，卒寢不行。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, in the end it was shelved and not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, it was ultimately shelved and never acted upon.

sentences.zh: 蔡天祐，字成之，睢州人。

translations.literal: Cai Tianyou, courtesy name Chengzhi, was a native of Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Tianyou, courtesy name Chengzhi, was a native of Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 父晟，濟南知府，以廉惠聞。

translations.literal: His father Sheng served as prefect of Jinan and was known for integrity and benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: His father Sheng served as prefect of Jinan and was known for integrity and benevolence.

sentences.zh: 天祐登弘治十八年進士，改庶起士，授吏科給事中，出為福建僉事。

translations.literal: Tianyou passed the jinshi examination in the eighteenth year of Hongzhi, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed a supervising secretary in the Bureau of Personnel, and later left office to serve as an assistant commissioner in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou passed the jinshi examination in the eighteenth year of Hongzhi, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, was appointed a supervising secretary in the Bureau of Personnel, and was later dispatched to serve as an assistant commissioner in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 曆山東副使，分巡遼陽。

translations.literal: He successively served as vice commissioner of Shandong, with jurisdiction over Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as vice commissioner of Shandong, with jurisdiction over Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 歲歉，活饑民萬余。

translations.literal: In a year of famine, he saved more than ten thousand starving people.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of famine, he saved more than ten thousand starving people.

sentences.zh: 辟濱海圩田數萬頃，民名之曰「蔡公田」。

translations.literal: He opened tens of thousands of qing of coastal polder fields, and the people called them "Lord Cai's Fields."
translations.idiomatic: He opened tens of thousands of qing of coastal polder fields, and the people called them "Lord Cai's Fields."

sentences.zh: 累遷山西按察使。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to become provincial surveillance commissioner of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted until he became provincial surveillance commissioner of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三年，大同兵亂，巡撫張文錦遇害。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiajing, soldiers mutinied at Datong, and Grand Coordinator Zhang Wenjin was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jiajing, the troops at Datong mutinied, and Grand Coordinator Zhang Wenjin was killed.

sentences.zh: 詔曲赦亂卒，改巡撫宣府都御史李鐸撫之。

translations.literal: An edict offered a partial amnesty to the mutinous troops, and Li Duo, censor-in-chief of Xuanfu who had been reassigned as grand coordinator, was ordered to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict offered a partial amnesty to the mutinous troops and ordered Li Duo, censor-in-chief of Xuanfu, reassigned as grand coordinator, to pacify them.

sentences.zh: 鐸以母憂不至，乃擢天祐右僉都御史，巡撫大同。

translations.literal: Li Duo did not arrive on account of mourning for his mother, so Tianyou was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and appointed grand coordinator of Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Duo did not arrive because he was in mourning for his mother, so Tianyou was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief and appointed grand coordinator of Datong.

sentences.zh: 天祐從數騎馳入城，諭軍士獻首惡，眾心稍定。

translations.literal: Tianyou rode into the city with only a few horsemen, exhorted the soldiers to surrender the ringleaders, and the people's hearts gradually settled.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou rode into the city with only a few horsemen, urged the soldiers to hand over the ringleaders, and the people's hearts gradually settled.

sentences.zh: 會尚書金獻民、總兵官杭雄出師甘肅，道大同，亂卒疑見討，復鼓噪。

translations.literal: At that time Minister Jin Xianmin and Regional Commander Hang Xiong were leading troops to Gansu and passed through Datong; the mutinous soldiers suspected they had come to punish them and raised a clamor again.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Minister Jin Xianmin and Regional Commander Hang Xiong were leading troops to Gansu and passed through Datong; the mutinous soldiers suspected they had come to punish them and raised a clamor again.

sentences.zh: 天祐懼，急請再赦。

translations.literal: Tianyou was afraid and urgently requested another amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou was afraid and urgently requested another amnesty.

sentences.zh: 兵部言「元惡不除無以警後」。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War stated, "Unless the chief offenders are removed there is no way to warn those who come after."
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War stated, "Unless the chief offenders are removed, there is no way to warn those who come after."

sentences.zh: 請特遣大臣總督宣、大軍務，以制其變。

translations.literal: They requested that a high minister be specially dispatched to take overall command of military affairs in Xuanfu and Datong, so as to control the situation.
translations.idiomatic: They requested that a high minister be specially dispatched to take overall command of military affairs in Xuanfu and Datong so as to control the situation.

sentences.zh: 乃命戶部侍郎胡瓚偕都督魯綱統京軍三千人以往。

translations.literal: Hu Zan, vice minister of Revenue, was therefore ordered to go together with Regional Commander Lu Gang, commanding three thousand capital troops.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zan, vice minister of Revenue, was therefore ordered to go with Regional Commander Lu Gang at the head of three thousand capital troops.

sentences.zh: 瓚等未發而進士李枝齎餉銀至。

translations.literal: Before Hu Zan and the others set out, presented scholar Li Zhi arrived bearing silver for military provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Before Hu Zan and the others set out, presented scholar Li Zhi arrived bearing silver for military provisions.

sentences.zh: 亂卒曰：「此承密詔盡殺大同人，為軍犒也。

translations.literal: The mutinous soldiers said, "This, in accordance with a secret edict, is to slaughter all the people of Datong as reward for the army."
translations.idiomatic: The mutinous soldiers said, "This silver, they say, comes under a secret edict to slaughter all the people of Datong as reward for the army."

sentences.zh: 」夜中火起，圍枝館，出牒示之乃解。

translations.literal: That night a fire broke out; they surrounded Li Zhi's lodging, and only when documents were produced and shown to them did they disperse.
translations.idiomatic: That night a fire broke out; they surrounded Li Zhi's lodging, and only when official documents were produced and shown to them did they disperse.

sentences.zh: 尋復殺知縣王文昌，圍代王府，脅王奏乞赦。

translations.literal: Soon after they again killed Magistrate Wang Wenchang, besieged the Princely Estate of Dai, and forced the prince to memorialize begging amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after they killed Magistrate Wang Wenchang, besieged the Princely Estate of Dai, and forced the prince to memorialize begging for amnesty.

sentences.zh: 王急攜二郡王走宣府。

translations.literal: The prince hastily took two commandery princes and fled to Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: The prince hastily took two commandery princes and fled to Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 巡按御史王官言：「亂卒方囂，大兵壓境，是趣之叛也。

translations.literal: Touring Censor Wang Guan stated, "The mutinous troops are just now rampant; with a large army pressing the border, this will only drive them to rebel."
translations.idiomatic: Touring Censor Wang Guan stated, "The mutinous troops are still rampant; with a large army pressing the border, this will only drive them to rebel."

sentences.zh: 請亟止禁軍，容臣密圖。

translations.literal: I beg that the capital troops be stopped immediately and that your subject be allowed to plot in secret."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that the capital troops be halted at once and that your subject be allowed to work out a secret plan."

sentences.zh: 」乃命瓚駐兵宣府。

translations.literal: Hu Zan was therefore ordered to halt his troops at Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zan was therefore ordered to halt his troops at Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 頃之，天祐奏總兵官桂勇已捕五十四人，請止京軍勿遣。

translations.literal: Before long Tianyou memorialized that Regional Commander Gui Yong had already captured fifty-four men, and requested that the capital troops not be sent.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Tianyou memorialized that Regional Commander Gui Yong had already captured fifty-four men and requested that the capital troops not be dispatched.

sentences.zh: 帝責以阻撓，令必獲首惡郭鑒等。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked him for obstruction and ordered that the ringleaders, Guo Jian and the others, must certainly be captured.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rebuked him for obstruction and ordered that the ringleaders, Guo Jian and the others, must be captured without fail.

sentences.zh: 既而瓚次陽和，勇、天祐令千戶苗登擒斬鑒等十一人，函首送瓚，請班師。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter Hu Zan stopped at Yanghe; Gui Yong and Tianyou had Centurion Miao Deng capture and behead Jian and eleven others, sent the heads in a box to Hu Zan, and requested withdrawal of the army.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly thereafter Hu Zan halted at Yanghe; Gui Yong and Tianyou had Centurion Miao Deng capture and behead Jian and eleven others, sent the heads in a box to Hu Zan, and requested withdrawal of the army.

sentences.zh: 甫二日，鑒父郭疤子復糾徐氈兒等夜殺勇家人，又毀苗登家。

translations.literal: Barely two days later, Jian's father Guo Bazi again rallied Xu Zhan'er and others to kill Gui Yong's family by night, and they also destroyed Miao Deng's home.
translations.idiomatic: Barely two days later, Jian's father Guo Bazi rallied Xu Zhan'er and others to kill Gui Yong's family by night and also destroyed Miao Deng's home.

sentences.zh: 瓚言非盡殲不可。

translations.literal: Hu Zan stated that unless they were completely exterminated it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zan stated that unless the rebels were completely exterminated, the problem could not be solved.

sentences.zh: 帝乃切讓天祐，召勇還京，以故總兵硃振代之，敕瓚仍駐宣府。

translations.literal: The Emperor then sharply rebuked Tianyou, recalled Gui Yong to the capital, replaced him with the former regional commander Zhu Zhen, and ordered Hu Zan to remain stationed at Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor then sharply rebuked Tianyou, recalled Gui Yong to the capital, replaced him with the former regional commander Zhu Zhen, and ordered Hu Zan to remain stationed at Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 居無何，天祐捕戮徐氈兒等，瓚等遂班師。

translations.literal: Before long Tianyou captured and executed Xu Zhan'er and the others, whereupon Hu Zan and the others withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Tianyou captured and executed Xu Zhan'er and the others, whereupon Hu Zan and the others withdrew the army.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，侍郎李昆、孟春，總兵官馬永交章言疤子潛逃塞外，必為後患。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year, Vice Ministers Li Kun and Meng Chun, and Regional Commander Ma Yong, submitted memorials one after another stating that Bazi had escaped secretly beyond the frontier and would surely become a future menace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year, Vice Ministers Li Kun and Meng Chun and Regional Commander Ma Yong submitted memorials one after another stating that Bazi had slipped away beyond the frontier and would surely become a future menace.

sentences.zh: 帝將遣使勘，會瓚還京言逃卒無足患，帝乃罷勘官勿遣。

translations.literal: The Emperor was about to dispatch an envoy to investigate, but when Hu Zan returned to the capital and stated that the escaped soldiers were not worth worrying about, the Emperor therefore cancelled the investigation and did not send the envoy.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was about to dispatch an envoy to investigate, but when Hu Zan returned to the capital and said the escaped soldiers were not worth worrying about, the Emperor cancelled the investigation and did not send the envoy.

sentences.zh: 疤子復潛入城，焚振第。

translations.literal: Bazi again slipped secretly into the city and burned Zhu Zhen's residence.
translations.idiomatic: Bazi again slipped secretly into the city and burned Zhu Zhen's residence.

sentences.zh: 明旦，天祐閉城大索。

translations.literal: At dawn the next day Tianyou closed the city and conducted a major search.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the next day Tianyou closed the city and conducted a major search.

sentences.zh: 獲疤子及其黨三十四人，悉斬以徇。

translations.literal: They captured Bazi and thirty-four of his followers, and all were beheaded as a public warning.
translations.idiomatic: They captured Bazi and thirty-four of his followers, and all were beheaded as a public warning.

sentences.zh: 盡宥脅從，人心乃大定。

translations.literal: All who had been coerced were fully pardoned, and popular sentiment was greatly settled.
translations.idiomatic: All who had been coerced were fully pardoned, and the people's hearts were greatly settled.

sentences.zh: 事聞，賚銀幣。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, he was granted silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, he was granted silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 已，進副都御史，巡撫如故。

translations.literal: Afterward he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief, continuing as before as grand coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief while continuing as grand coordinator.

sentences.zh: 尋就進兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: Before long he was further promoted directly to Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted directly to vice minister of War.

sentences.zh: 久之，召還部。

translations.literal: After a long time he was recalled to the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was recalled to the ministry.

sentences.zh: 天祐以籓祿久缺，又歲當繕邊垣，用便宜增淮鹽引價，每引萬加銀五千，被訐。

translations.literal: Tianyou, because princely stipends had long been lacking and because it was the year when the border ramparts were to be repaired, used discretionary authority to raise the price of Huai salt certificates—adding five thousand taels of silver per ten-thousand-certificate unit—and was impeached.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou, because princely stipends had long gone unpaid and because it was the year when the border ramparts were to be repaired, used discretionary authority to raise the price of Huai salt certificates by five thousand taels of silver per certificate, and was impeached.

sentences.zh: 帝宥之。

translations.literal: The Emperor pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 至是，御史李宗樞復追論前事，天祐因引疾去。

translations.literal: At this time Censor Li Zongshu again pursued prosecution of the earlier matter, and Tianyou therefore cited illness and resigned.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Censor Li Zongshu again pursued prosecution of the earlier matter, and Tianyou therefore cited illness and resigned.

sentences.zh: 居二年，奉詔起用。

translations.literal: Two years later he was summoned by imperial edict to serve again.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he was summoned by imperial edict to serve again.

sentences.zh: 未至京，得疾告歸，卒。

translations.literal: Before reaching the capital he fell ill, requested to return home, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Before reaching the capital he fell ill, requested to return home, and died.

sentences.zh: 年九十五。

translations.literal: He was ninety-five years old.
translations.idiomatic: He was ninety-five years old.

sentences.zh: 天祐有才智。

translations.literal: Tianyou was talented and resourceful.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou was talented and resourceful.

sentences.zh: 兵變時。

translations.literal: During the military mutiny,
translations.idiomatic: During the military mutiny,

sentences.zh: 左右皆賊耳目，幕府動靜悉知之。

translations.literal: those at his side were all the rebels' eyes and ears; every movement of the headquarters they knew in full.
translations.idiomatic: those around him were all the rebels' eyes and ears; every movement at headquarters was known to them in full.

sentences.zh: 天祐廣招星卜藝士往來軍中，因具得其情，卒賴以成功。

translations.literal: Tianyou widely recruited astrologers, diviners, and artisans to come and go in the army, and thereby came to know their situation completely; in the end he succeeded by relying on this.
translations.idiomatic: Tianyou widely recruited astrologers, diviners, and artisans to come and go in the army, and thereby learned their situation in full; in the end he succeeded by relying on this.

sentences.zh: 在鎮七年，威德大著，父老為立安輯祠。

translations.literal: During seven years in the garrison his authority and virtue greatly stood forth, and the elders established for him the Anji Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: During seven years in the garrison his authority and virtue greatly stood forth, and the local elders built for him the Anji Shrine.

sentences.zh: 胡瓚，字伯珩，永平人。

translations.literal: Hu Zan, courtesy name Boheng, was a native of Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Zan, courtesy name Boheng, was a native of Yongping.

sentences.zh: 進士。

translations.literal: He was a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He was a jinshi.

sentences.zh: 官終南京工部尚書。

translations.literal: He rose at last to Minister of Works at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He rose at last to minister of Works at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 張文錦，安丘人。
