translations.idiomatic: The ministry argued that the mobile troops of Yan-Sui had all been transferred to Xuan-Da, and that the raiders had been avoiding strong points to strike weak ones.

sentences.zh: 而我能以寡勝眾，宜錄其功。

translations.literal: Yet we were able to defeat the many with the few; their merit ought to be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Yet our forces had defeated a larger enemy with fewer men, and their merit ought to be recognized.

sentences.zh: 乃加守禮太子少保，學謫外。

translations.literal: Thereupon Shouli was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Xue was demoted outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shouli was accordingly made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, while Yin Xue was demoted and sent outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 守禮尋以憂去。

translations.literal: Shouli soon left office on account of bereavement.
translations.idiomatic: Shouli soon left office to observe mourning.

sentences.zh: 俺答薄都城，廷臣首以守禮薦，詔趣上道。

translations.literal: When Altan approached the capital, court officials first recommended Shouli; an edict ordered him to hurry along the road.
translations.idiomatic: When Altan approached the capital, court officials were the first to recommend Shouli, and an edict ordered him to set out at once.

sentences.zh: 寇退，止不行。

translations.literal: When the raiders withdrew, the order to proceed was countermanded.
translations.idiomatic: When the raiders withdrew, the order for him to take up the post was countermanded.

sentences.zh: 久之卒。

translations.literal: After a long time he died.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he died.

sentences.zh: 張岳，字維喬，惠安人。

translations.literal: Zhang Yue, styled Weiqiao, was a man of Huian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue, styled Weiqiao, was a native of Huian.

sentences.zh: 自幼好學，以大儒自期。

translations.literal: From youth he loved study and set his sights on becoming a great Confucian scholar.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood he loved learning and aspired to become a great Confucian scholar.

sentences.zh: 登正德十一年進士，授行人。

translations.literal: He passed the metropolitan examination in the eleventh year of Zhengde and was appointed an attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the eleventh year of the Zhengde reign and was appointed an attendant.

sentences.zh: 武宗寢疾豹房。

translations.literal: Emperor Wuzong lay ill in the Leopard Quarter.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong lay gravely ill in the Leopard Quarter.

sentences.zh: 請令大臣侍從，台諫輪直起居，視藥餌，防意外變。

translations.literal: He requested that great ministers attend, that censorial and remonstrance officials rotate in attending to the emperor's rising and retiring and overseeing medicine, to guard against unforeseen events.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that senior ministers attend the emperor, that censorial and remonstrance officials take turns watching over his daily care and medicines, and that precautions be taken against any unforeseen turn of events.

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: No response was given.
translations.idiomatic: No response was given.

sentences.zh: 與同官諫南巡，杖闕下，謫南京國子學正。

translations.literal: Together with fellow officials he remonstrated against the southern tour; he was beaten at the palace gate and demoted to director of study at the Nanjing Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Together with his colleagues he remonstrated against the southern tour; he was beaten at the palace gate and demoted to director of study at the Nanjing Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 世宗嗣位，復故官，遷右司副。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shizong succeeded, he was restored to his former post and promoted to Right Division Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizong succeeded to the throne, Yue was restored to his former post and promoted to Right Division Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 母老乞便養，改南京武選員外郎，曆主客郎中。

translations.literal: His mother was elderly and he requested convenient care; he was transferred to Assistant Department Director of the Military Selection Bureau at Nanjing and successively served as bureau director of Receptions.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was elderly, and he requested a post that would allow him to care for her conveniently; he was transferred to Assistant Department Director of the Military Selection Bureau at Nanjing and later served as bureau director of Receptions.

sentences.zh: 方議大禘禮。

translations.literal: The grand di ritual was then under discussion.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the court was debating the grand di ritual.

sentences.zh: 張璁求始祖所自出者實之，禮官皆唯唯。

translations.literal: Zhang Cong sought to identify and substantiate the progenitor from whom the founder descended; the ritual officials all assented meekly.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cong sought to identify and substantiate the progenitor from whom the dynastic founder descended, and the ritual officials all assented without objection.

sentences.zh: 岳言于尚書李時曰：「不如為皇初祖位，毋實以人。

translations.literal: Yue said to Minister Li Shi: "Better to establish a place for the Founding Progenitor of the Emperor, without assigning a specific person to it.
translations.idiomatic: Yue said to Minister Li Shi: "It would be better to establish a place for the Founding Progenitor of the Emperor, without assigning a specific person to it.

sentences.zh: 」時大喜，告璁。

translations.literal: " Shi was greatly pleased and told Cong.
translations.idiomatic: " Li Shi was greatly pleased and told Zhang Cong.

sentences.zh: 璁不謂然，以初議上。

translations.literal: Cong disagreed and submitted the original proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Cong disagreed and submitted the original proposal to the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝竟令題皇初祖主，如嶽言。

translations.literal: The emperor ultimately ordered the spirit tablet inscribed as the Founding Progenitor of the Emperor, as Yue had said.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ultimately ordered the spirit tablet inscribed as the Founding Progenitor of the Emperor, just as Yue had proposed.

sentences.zh: 璁銜之，出為廣西提學僉事。

translations.literal: Cong bore a grudge and had him sent out as Education Intendant of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Cong bore a grudge against him and had him sent out to serve as Education Intendant of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 行部柳州，軍缺餉大嘩，城閉五日。

translations.literal: On an inspection tour in Liuzhou, troops lacking pay raised a great uproar; the city gates were closed for five days.
translations.idiomatic: While on an inspection tour in Liuzhou, troops who had not received their pay raised a great uproar, and the city gates remained closed for five days.

sentences.zh: 嶽令守城啟門，召詰嘩者予餉去。

translations.literal: Yue ordered those guarding the gates to open them, summoned and questioned the rioters, gave them pay, and sent them away.
translations.idiomatic: Yue ordered the gate guards to open the city, summoned the rioters for questioning, paid them their arrears, and sent them away.

sentences.zh: 尋以計擒首惡，置之理。

translations.literal: Soon by stratagem he captured the ringleaders and put them on trial.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he devised a stratagem that captured the ringleaders and brought them to justice.

sentences.zh: 入賀，改提學江西。

translations.literal: On entering the capital to offer congratulations, he was transferred to education intendant of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: When he entered the capital to offer congratulations, he was transferred to education intendant of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 不謝璁，璁黜廣西選貢七人，謫嶽廣東鹽課提舉。

translations.literal: He did not thank Cong; Cong dismissed seven selected tribute students from Guangxi and demoted Yue to Salt Tax Commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Yue did not thank Zhang Cong, so Cong dismissed seven selected tribute students from Guangxi and demoted Yue to Salt Tax Commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 遷廉州知府。

translations.literal: He was transferred to prefect of Lianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Lianzhou.

sentences.zh: 督民墾棄地，教以桔槔運水。

translations.literal: He supervised the people in reclaiming abandoned land and taught them to use the shaduf to draw water.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised the people in reclaiming abandoned land and taught them to use the shaduf to lift water for irrigation.

sentences.zh: 廉民多盜珠池。

translations.literal: The people of Lianzhou often stole from the pearl fisheries.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Lianzhou frequently poached from the pearl fisheries.

sentences.zh: 岳居四年，未嘗入一珠。

translations.literal: In four years as prefect Yue never took a single pearl.
translations.idiomatic: In four years as prefect, Yue never accepted a single pearl.

sentences.zh: 帝使使往安南詰莫登庸殺主，岳言于總督張經曰：「莫氏篡黎，可無勘而知也，使往受謾詞辱國，請留使者毋前。

translations.literal: The emperor dispatched an envoy to Annam to inquire into Mo Dangyong's murder of the ruler. Yue said to Grand Coordinator Zhang Jing: "The Mo clan usurped the Li; one need not investigate to know this. If the envoy goes he will accept evasive words and humiliate the state—please detain the envoy and do not let him proceed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor dispatched an envoy to Annam to inquire into Mo Dangyong's murder of the ruler. Yue said to Grand Coordinator Zhang Jing: "The Mo clan usurped the Li dynasty—one need not investigate to know that. If the envoy goes, he will only accept evasive words and humiliate the state. Please detain the envoy and do not let him proceed.

sentences.zh: 」經不可。

translations.literal: " Jing would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Jing would not agree.

sentences.zh: 知欽州林希元上書請決討莫氏，嶽貽書止之，復條上不可討六事。

translations.literal: Prefect of Qinzhou Lin Xiyuan submitted a memorial requesting a decisive campaign against the Mo; Yue wrote to stop him and also listed six reasons why a campaign should not be undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Xiyuan, prefect of Qinzhou, submitted a memorial requesting a decisive campaign against the Mo clan. Yue wrote to dissuade him and also listed six reasons why such a campaign should not be undertaken.

sentences.zh: 為書貽執政曰：「據邊民報，黎賙襲封無嗣，以兄子譓為子。

translations.literal: He wrote to the chief ministers: "According to border people's reports, Li Ku inherited the title but had no heir and adopted his elder brother's son Hui as son.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote to the chief ministers: "According to reports from border people, Li Ku inherited the title but had no heir and adopted his elder brother's son Hui as his own.

sentences.zh: 陳暠作亂，賙遇害，暠篡。

translations.literal: Chen Gao raised a rebellion; Ku was killed; Gao usurped.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Gao raised a rebellion; Li Ku was killed, and Gao usurped the throne.

sentences.zh: 未幾國人擁立譓，暠奔諒山。

translations.literal: Before long the people installed Hui; Gao fled to Lang Son.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the people installed Hui as ruler, and Gao fled to Lang Son.

sentences.zh: 訁惠立七年，為莫登庸所逼，出居昇華。

translations.literal: Hui had reigned seven years when forced by Mo Dangyong, he withdrew to reside at Sheng Hua.
translations.idiomatic: Hui had reigned seven years when Mo Dangyong forced him out; he withdrew to reside at Sheng Hua.

sentences.zh: 登庸立譓幼弟騑而相之，卒弑騑自立，國分為三。

translations.literal: Dangyong installed Hui's younger brother Fei and acted as regent; in the end he assassinated Fei and usurped the throne; the state split into three.
translations.idiomatic: Dangyong installed Hui's younger brother Fei and acted as regent, but in the end he assassinated Fei and seized the throne himself, and the country split into three parts.

sentences.zh: 黎在南，莫居中，陳在西北。

translations.literal: The Li were in the south, the Mo in the center, the Chen in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: The Li held the south, the Mo the center, and the Chen the northwest.

sentences.zh: 後諒山亦為登庸有，陳遂絕。

translations.literal: Later Lang Son also fell to Dangyong, and the Chen line ended.
translations.idiomatic: Later Lang Son also fell to Dangyong, and the Chen line came to an end.

sentences.zh: 而黎所居即古日南地，與占城鄰，限大海，登庸不能逾之南，故兩存。

translations.literal: The Li domain was the ancient Rinan territory, bordering Champa and bounded by the great sea; Dangyong could not cross south of it, so both survived.
translations.idiomatic: The Li domain occupied the ancient Rinan territory, bordering Champa and bounded by the sea; Dangyong could not cross south of it, and so both regimes survived.

sentences.zh: 近登庸又以交州付其孫福海，而自營海東府地都齋居之。

translations.literal: Recently Dangyong also handed Jiaozhou to his grandson Fuhai, while he himself established residence at Didu in the Hai Dong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Dangyong also handed Jiaozhou over to his grandson Fuhai, while he himself took up residence at Didu in Hai Dong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 蓋安南諸府，惟海東地最大，即所謂王山郡也。

translations.literal: Among Annam's prefectures, Hai Dong had the largest territory—the so-called Wangshan commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Of all the prefectures in Annam, Hai Dong had the largest territory—the so-called Wangshan commandery.

sentences.zh: 此賊負篡逆名，常練兵備我，又時揚言求入貢。

translations.literal: This rebel bears the name of usurper and rebel; he constantly drills troops against us and from time to time announces he seeks to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: This rebel bears the stigma of usurpation and treason; he constantly drills troops against us and from time to time announces that he wishes to offer tribute.

sentences.zh: 邊人以非故王也，弗敢聞。

translations.literal: Border people, knowing he is not the former king, dare not report it.
translations.idiomatic: Border officials, knowing he was not the former king, dared not report it to the court.

sentences.zh: 愚以為彼內亂未嘗有所侵犯，可且置之，待其亂定乃貢。

translations.literal: I think that though they have internal disorder, they have not invaded us; we may set the matter aside for now and wait until order is restored before accepting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: I believe that although they are torn by internal disorder, they have not invaded us; we may set the matter aside for now and wait until their turmoil subsides before accepting tribute.

sentences.zh: 若必用兵，勝負利純非嶽所敢知。

translations.literal: If force must be used, the outcome and gain or loss are not something Yue dares presume to know.
translations.idiomatic: If force must be used, the outcome and whether it would bring gain or loss are not matters I dare presume to judge.

sentences.zh: 」執政得書不能決。

translations.literal: " The chief ministers received the letter but could not decide.
translations.idiomatic: " The chief ministers received the letter but could not reach a decision.

sentences.zh: 已，毛伯溫來視師，張經一以軍事委嶽。

translations.literal: Before long Mao Bowen came to inspect the army; Zhang Jing wholly entrusted military affairs to Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Mao Bowen arrived to inspect the army, and Zhang Jing wholly entrusted military affairs to Yue.

sentences.zh: 又以翁萬達才，進二人于伯溫。

translations.literal: He also recommended Weng Wanda for his talent and presented both men to Bowen.
translations.idiomatic: He also recommended Weng Wanda for his talent and presented both men to Mao Bowen.

sentences.zh: 岳與伯溫語數日，伯溫曰：「交事屬君矣。

translations.literal: Yue spoke with Bowen for several days; Bowen said: "The Annam affair is yours to manage.
translations.idiomatic: Yue spoke with Mao Bowen for several days, and Bowen said: "The Annam affair is yours to manage.

sentences.zh: 」許登庸如嶽議。

translations.literal: " It was agreed that Dangyong would comply with Yue's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: " It was agreed that Dangyong would comply with Yue's proposal.

sentences.zh: 會嶽遷浙江提學副使，又遷參政，伯溫馳奏留之，乃改廣東參政，分守海北。

translations.literal: Just as Yue was transferred to Vice Education Intendant of Zhejiang and then to Administration Vice Commissioner, Bowen urgently memorialized to retain him; he was then changed to Administration Vice Commissioner of Guangdong, with charge of the Haibei circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Just as Yue was transferred to Vice Education Intendant of Zhejiang and then to Administration Vice Commissioner, Mao Bowen urgently memorialized to retain him; he was then reassigned as Administration Vice Commissioner of Guangdong, with charge of the Haibei circuit.

sentences.zh: 登庸降，加嶽俸一級，賜銀幣。

translations.literal: When Dangyong surrendered, Yue's salary was raised one grade and he was granted silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: When Dangyong surrendered, Yue's salary was raised one grade and he was granted silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 尋以征瓊州叛黎功，加俸及賜如之。

translations.literal: Soon for merit in subduing the rebel Li of Qiongzhou, salary increment and rewards were granted likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, for his merit in suppressing the rebel Li of Qiongzhou, he received the same salary increase and rewards.

sentences.zh: 塞上多事，言官薦岳邊才。

translations.literal: The frontier was troubled; censorial officials recommended Yue for frontier talent.
translations.idiomatic: With trouble mounting on the frontier, censorial officials recommended Yue for his frontier expertise.

sentences.zh: 伯溫言：「岳可南，翁萬達可北也。

translations.literal: Bowen said: "Yue can serve in the south, Weng Wanda in the north.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Bowen said: "Yue can serve in the south, and Weng Wanda in the north.

sentences.zh: 」遂擢嶽右僉都御史，撫治鄖陽。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Yue was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right and appointed Pacification Commissioner of Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: " Yue was accordingly promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right and appointed Pacification Commissioner of Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 旋移撫江西，進右副都御史，總督兩廣軍務兼巡撫。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to grand coordinator of Jiangxi, promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right, and given overall military affairs in the two Guang with concurrent duties as grand coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to serve as grand coordinator of Jiangxi, promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right, and given overall military affairs in the two Guang with concurrent duties as grand coordinator.

sentences.zh: 討破廣東封川僮蘇公樂等，進兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: He campaigned against and defeated the Yao Su Gongle and others of Fengchuan in Guangdong and was promoted to Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned against and defeated the Yao bandits Su Gongle and others of Fengchuan in Guangdong, and was promoted to Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 平廣西馬平諸縣瑤賊，先後俘斬四千，招撫二萬餘人，誅賊魁韋金田等，增俸一級。

translations.literal: He pacified the Yao bandits of various counties including Maping in Guangxi; in all four thousand were captured or beheaded, more than twenty thousand were brought in through appeasement; bandit chiefs including Wei Jintian were executed; salary raised one grade.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified the Yao bandits of Maping and other counties in Guangxi; in all four thousand were captured or beheaded, more than twenty thousand were brought in through appeasement, bandit chiefs including Wei Jintian were executed, and his salary was raised one grade.

sentences.zh: 召為刑部右侍郎，以御史徐南金言命留任。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of Justice, but on the word of Censor Xu Nanjin the order was changed and he was kept in his post.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to serve as Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of Justice, but on the recommendation of Censor Xu Nanjin the order was changed and he was kept in his post.

sentences.zh: 連山賊李金與賀縣賊倪仲亮等，出沒衡、永、郴、桂，積三十年不能平，嶽大合兵討擒之。

translations.literal: Bandits Li Jin of Lianshan and Ni Zhongliang of Hexian and others, operating in Heng, Yong, Chen, and Gui for thirty years without being suppressed—Yue massed troops and campaigned, capturing them.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jin, bandit leader of Lianshan, and Ni Zhongliang of Hexian and others had raided across Heng, Yong, Chen, and Gui for thirty years without being suppressed; Yue massed troops, campaigned against them, and captured them.

sentences.zh: 蒞鎮四年，巨寇悉平，召拜兵部左侍郎。

translations.literal: After four years at his post all major bandits were suppressed; he was summoned and appointed Vice Minister of the Left in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: After four years in his post all major bandits had been suppressed, and he was summoned and appointed Vice Minister of the Left in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 湖貴間有山曰蠟爾，諸苗居之。

translations.literal: Between Huguang and Guizhou there is a mountain called La'er where various Miao peoples dwell.
translations.idiomatic: Between Huguang and Guizhou there is a mountain called La'er, where various Miao peoples dwell.

sentences.zh: 東屬鎮溪千戶所筸子坪長官司，隸湖廣；

translations.literal: To the east it belongs to the Gaoziping native office under Zhenxi Guard, subordinate to Huguang;
translations.idiomatic: To the east it fell under the Gaoziping native office of Zhenxi Guard, subordinate to Huguang;

sentences.zh: 西屬銅仁、平頭二長官司，隸貴州；

translations.literal: to the west it belongs to the two native offices of Tongren and Pingtou, subordinate to Guizhou;
translations.idiomatic: to the west it fell under the two native offices of Tongren and Pingtou, subordinate to Guizhou;

sentences.zh: 北接四川酉陽，廣袤數百里。

translations.literal: to the north it adjoins Youyang in Sichuan, extending several hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: to the north it adjoined Youyang in Sichuan, and stretched several hundred li across.

sentences.zh: 諸苗數反，官兵不能制。

translations.literal: The Miao frequently rebel and government troops cannot suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao there rebelled repeatedly, and government troops could not suppress them.

sentences.zh: 侍郎萬鏜征之，四年不克。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Wan Ying campaigned against them for four years without success.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Wan Ying campaigned against them for four years without success.

sentences.zh: 乃授其魁龍許保冠帶。

translations.literal: Thereupon the chieftain Long Xubao was granted an official cap and belt.
translations.idiomatic: The chieftain Long Xubao was then granted an official cap and belt as a mark of recognition.

sentences.zh: 湖苗暫息，而貴苗反如故。

translations.literal: The Miao of Huguang temporarily subsided, but those of Guizhou rebelled as before.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao in Huguang temporarily quieted down, but those in Guizhou rose in rebellion again as before.

sentences.zh: 鏜班師，龍許保及其党吳黑苗復亂。

translations.literal: Ying withdrew his army; Long Xubao and his follower Wu Heimiao rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: When Wan Ying withdrew his army, Long Xubao and his follower Wu Heimiao rebelled once more.

sentences.zh: 貴州巡撫李義壯告警，乃命岳總督湖廣、貴州、四川軍務，討之。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator of Guizhou Li Yizhuang reported the alarm; Yue was ordered to take overall military affairs in Huguang, Guizhou, and Sichuan and campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator of Guizhou Li Yizhuang reported the emergency, and Zhang Yue was ordered to take overall military affairs in Huguang, Guizhou, and Sichuan and campaign against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 進右都御史。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Censor-in-Chief of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to the post of Censor-in-Chief of the Right.

sentences.zh: 義壯持鏜議欲撫，嶽劾其阻兵，罷之。

translations.literal: Yizhuang upheld Ying's proposal to appease them; Yue impeached him for obstructing military action and had him dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yizhuang upheld Wan Ying's proposal to appease the rebels, but Zhang Yue impeached him for obstructing military action and had him removed from office.

sentences.zh: 先義壯撫貴州者，僉都御史王學益與鏜附嚴嵩，主撫議，數從中撓嶽。

translations.literal: Wang Xueyi, Vice Censor-in-Chief, who had preceded Yizhuang in pacifying Guizhou, together with Ying attached himself to Yan Song, advocated appeasement, and repeatedly interfered with Yue from within the court.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xueyi, Vice Censor-in-Chief, who had preceded Li Yizhuang in pacifying Guizhou, together with Wan Ying had attached himself to Yan Song, advocated appeasement, and repeatedly interfered with Zhang Yue from within the court.

sentences.zh: 嶽持益堅。

translations.literal: Yue held all the more firmly to his position.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue held all the more firmly to his position.

sentences.zh: 許保襲執印江知縣徐文伯及石阡推官鄧本忠以去，嶽坐停俸。

translations.literal: Xubao raided and seized Magistrate of Yinjiang Xu Wenbo and Push Official of Shiqian Deng Benzhong and carried them off; Yue was punished with suspension of salary.
translations.idiomatic: Xubao raided and seized Magistrate of Yinjiang Xu Wenbo and Push Official of Shiqian Deng Benzhong and carried them off, and Zhang Yue was punished with suspension of salary.

sentences.zh: 乃使總兵官沈希儀、參將石邦憲等分道進，躬入銅仁督之。

translations.literal: He then sent Commander-in-Chief Shen Xiyi, Assistant Regional Commander Shi Bangxian, and others to advance by separate routes, and personally entered Tongren to direct operations.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent Commander-in-Chief Shen Xiyi, Assistant Regional Commander Shi Bangxian, and others to advance by separate routes, while he personally entered Tongren to direct operations.

sentences.zh: 先後斬賊魁五十三人，獨許保、黑苗跳不獲。

translations.literal: In succession fifty-three bandit chiefs were beheaded; only Xubao and Heimiao escaped and could not be captured.
translations.idiomatic: In succession fifty-three bandit chiefs were beheaded, but Xubao and Heimiao alone escaped and could not be captured.

sentences.zh: 岳以捷聞，言貴苗漸平，湖苗聽撫，請遣土兵歸農，朝議許之。

translations.literal: Yue reported the victory, saying the Guizhou Miao were gradually pacified and the Huguang Miao were willing to submit to appeasement; he requested that native troops be sent back to farming, and the court approved.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue reported the victory, stating that the Guizhou Miao were gradually being pacified and the Huguang Miao were willing to submit to appeasement; he requested that native troops be sent back to their farms, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 未幾，酉陽宣慰冉元嗾許保、黑苗突思州，劫執知府李允簡。

translations.literal: Before long, Pacification Commissioner of Youyang Ran Yuan incited Xubao and Heimiao to raid Sizhou and seize Prefect Li Yunjian.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Pacification Commissioner of Youyang Ran Yuan incited Xubao and Heimiao to raid Sizhou and abduct Prefect Li Yunjian.

sentences.zh: 邦憲兵邀奪允簡還，允簡竟死。

translations.literal: Bangxian's troops intercepted and recovered Yunjian, but Yunjian died in the end.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Bangxian's troops intercepted the raiders and recovered Li Yunjian, but Yunjian died in the end.

sentences.zh: 嵩父子故憾岳，欲逮治之，徐階持不可。

translations.literal: The father and son Yan bore an old grudge against Yue and wished to have him arrested and punished; Xu Jie held that this should not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Song and his son bore an old grudge against Zhang Yue and wished to have him arrested and punished, but Xu Jie argued against it.

sentences.zh: 乃奪右都御史，以兵部侍郎督師。

translations.literal: Thereupon he was stripped of the title Censor-in-Chief of the Right and retained as Vice Minister of War to direct the army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue was accordingly stripped of the title Censor-in-Chief of the Right and retained as Vice Minister of War to direct the army.

sentences.zh: 邦憲等旋破賊。

translations.literal: Bangxian and the others soon defeated the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Bangxian and the others soon defeated the bandits.

sentences.zh: 岳搜山箐，餘賊獻思州印及許保。

translations.literal: Yue searched the mountain ravines; the remaining bandits surrendered the seal of Sizhou and Xubao.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue searched the mountain ravines, and the remaining bandits surrendered the seal of Sizhou and turned over Xubao.

sentences.zh: 湖廣兵亦破擒首惡李通海等。

translations.literal: The troops of Huguang also defeated and captured the ringleaders Li Tonghai and others.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang troops also defeated the rebels and captured the ringleaders Li Tonghai and others.

sentences.zh: 岳以黑苗未獲，不敢報功。

translations.literal: Yue, because Heimiao had not yet been captured, did not dare report merit.
translations.idiomatic: Because Heimiao had not yet been captured, Zhang Yue did not dare report his achievements.

sentences.zh: 已而冉元謀露，嶽發其奸。

translations.literal: Before long Ran Yuan's plot was exposed; Yue revealed his treachery.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Ran Yuan's plot was exposed, and Zhang Yue revealed his treachery.

sentences.zh: 元賄嚴世蕃責岳絕苗黨。

translations.literal: Yuan bribed Yan Shifan to rebuke Yue for cutting off the Miao faction.
translations.idiomatic: Ran Yuan bribed Yan Shifan to rebuke Zhang Yue for cutting off ties with the Miao faction.

sentences.zh: 邦憲竟得黑苗以獻，苗患乃息。

translations.literal: Bangxian in the end captured Heimiao and presented him; the Miao trouble then ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Bangxian in the end captured Heimiao and presented him to the court, and the Miao trouble then ceased.

sentences.zh: 岳卒於沅州。

translations.literal: Yue died at Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue died at Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 喪歸，沅人迎哭者不絕。

translations.literal: When the coffin returned, the people of Yuan came out to weep without cease.
translations.idiomatic: When his coffin returned home, the people of Yuan came out to weep along the route without cease.

sentences.zh: 已，敘功，復右都御史，贈太子少保，諡襄惠。

translations.literal: Later his merit was recorded; he was restored as Censor-in-Chief of the Right, posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and given the posthumous title Xianghui.
translations.idiomatic: Later his achievements were recognized; he was posthumously restored as Censor-in-Chief of the Right, granted the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and given the posthumous title Xianghui.

sentences.zh: 岳博覽，工文章，經術湛深，不喜王守仁學，以程、硃為宗。

translations.literal: Yue was broadly learned, skilled in literary composition, and deeply versed in classical learning; he did not favor the teachings of Wang Shouren and took the Cheng-Zhu school as his standard.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yue was broadly learned, skilled in literary composition, and deeply versed in classical learning; he did not favor the teachings of Wang Shouren and took the Cheng-Zhu school as his standard.

sentences.zh: 李允簡，融縣人。

translations.literal: Li Yunjian was a man of Rong County.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yunjian was a native of Rong County.

sentences.zh: 由舉人起家。

translations.literal: He began his career as a provincial graduate.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 以郡境多寇，道孥歸，獨與孫炳文居。

translations.literal: Because the prefecture was troubled by many bandits, he sent his wife and children home on the road and lived alone with his grandson Bingwen.
translations.idiomatic: Because the prefecture was troubled by many bandits, he sent his wife and children home along the way and lived alone with his grandson Bingwen.

sentences.zh: 祖孫皆被執，許保挾以求厚贖。

translations.literal: Both grandfather and grandson were seized; Xubao held them to demand a heavy ransom.
translations.idiomatic: Both grandfather and grandson were seized, and Xubao held them hostage to demand a heavy ransom.

sentences.zh: 允簡則傳語邦憲令亟進兵。

translations.literal: Yunjian, for his part, sent word to Bangxian ordering him to advance troops at once.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yunjian, for his part, sent word to Shi Bangxian ordering him to advance troops at once.

sentences.zh: 在賊中自投高崖下，賊拽出，棄之途。

translations.literal: While among the bandits he threw himself from a high cliff; the bandits pulled him out and abandoned him on the road.
translations.idiomatic: While held by the bandits he threw himself from a high cliff; they pulled him out and left him on the road.

sentences.zh: 思人舁還，至清浪衛而卒。

translations.literal: The people of Si carried him back; he died upon reaching Qinglang Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Sizhou carried him back, but he died upon reaching Qinglang Guard.

sentences.zh: 詔贈貴州副使，賜祭葬，官一子。

translations.literal: An edict posthumously granted him Vice Commissioner of Guizhou, bestowed sacrificial rites and burial honors, and appointed one son to office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posthumously granted him the rank of Vice Commissioner of Guizhou, bestowed sacrificial rites and burial honors, and appointed one of his sons to office.

sentences.zh: 郭宗皋，字君弼，福山人。

translations.literal: Guo Zonggao, styled Junbi, was a man of Fushan.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zonggao, styled Junbi, was a native of Fushan.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖八年進士。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiajing he became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in the eighth year of the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 選庶起士。

translations.literal: He was selected as a Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: He was chosen as a Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 尋詔與選者皆改除，得刑部主事。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered all those selected to be reassigned; he received appointment as a principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict ordered all those selected to be reassigned, and he was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 擢御史。

translations.literal: He was promoted to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was elevated to censor.

sentences.zh: 十二年十月，星隕如雨。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twelfth year, stars fell like rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twelfth year, stars fell like rain across the sky.

sentences.zh: 未幾，哀沖太子薨，大同兵亂。

translations.literal: Before long Crown Prince Aichong died, and the troops at Datong mutinied.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Crown Prince Aichong died, and the garrison at Datong mutinied.

sentences.zh: 宗皋勸帝惇崇寬厚，察納忠言，勿專以嚴明為治。

translations.literal: Zonggao urged the emperor to esteem and practice generosity and magnanimity, discern and accept loyal counsel, and not govern solely through severity and rigor.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zonggao urged the emperor to esteem and practice generosity and magnanimity, discern and accept loyal counsel, and not govern solely through severity and rigor.

sentences.zh: 帝大怒，下詔獄，杖四十釋之。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly angered, had him sent to the imperial prison, beaten forty strokes, and released.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly angered, had him sent to the imperial prison, beaten forty strokes, and then released.

sentences.zh: 曆按蘇、松、順天。

translations.literal: He successively served as touring censor of Suzhou, Songjiang, and Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as touring censor of Suzhou, Songjiang, and Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 行部乘馬，不禦肩輿。

translations.literal: On inspection tours he rode a horse and did not use a sedan chair.
translations.idiomatic: When touring his jurisdiction he rode horseback and refused a sedan chair.

sentences.zh: 會廷推保定巡撫劉夔還理院事，宗皋論夔嘗薦大學士李時子，諂媚無行，不任風紀，坐奪俸兩月。

translations.literal: When the court recommended Grand Coordinator of Baoding Liu Kui to return and handle affairs at the censorate, Zonggao argued that Kui had once recommended the son of Grand Secretary Li Shi, was fawning and without integrity, and was unfit for censorial discipline; he was punished with two months' salary withheld.
translations.idiomatic: When the court recommended Grand Coordinator of Baoding Liu Kui to return and handle affairs at the censorate, Guo Zonggao argued that Liu Kui had once recommended the son of Grand Secretary Li Shi, was fawning and without integrity, and was unfit for censorial discipline; Zonggao was punished with two months' salary withheld.

sentences.zh: 尋出為雁門兵備副使，轉陝西參政，遷大理少卿。

translations.literal: Soon he was sent out as Military Defense Vice Commissioner of Yanmen, transferred to Administration Vice Commissioner of Shaanxi, and promoted to Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sent out as Military Defense Vice Commissioner of Yanmen, transferred to Administration Vice Commissioner of Shaanxi, and promoted to Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 二十三年十月，寇入萬全右衛，抵廣昌，列營四十里。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twenty-third year, raiders entered Wanquan Right Guard, reached Guangchang, and encamped in a line forty li long.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the twenty-third year, raiders entered Wanquan Right Guard, reached Guangchang, and pitched camps in a line forty li long.

sentences.zh: 順天巡撫硃方下獄，擢宗皋右僉都御史代之，寇已去。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator of Shuntian Zhu Fang was imprisoned; Zonggao was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right to replace him, but the raiders had already withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator of Shuntian Zhu Fang was imprisoned; Guo Zonggao was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right to replace him, but the raiders had already withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 宗皋言：「密雲最要害，宜宿重兵。

translations.literal: Zonggao said: "Miyun is the most critical point and ought to hold a strong garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zonggao said: "Miyun is the most critical point and ought to hold a strong garrison.

sentences.zh: 乞敕馬蘭、太平、燕河三屯歲發千人，以五月赴密雲，有警則總兵官自將赴援。

translations.literal: I beg that an order be issued for the three garrisons of Malan, Taiping, and Yanhe each year to dispatch one thousand men in the fifth month to Miyun; when there is an alarm the commander-in-chief shall personally lead troops to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that orders be issued for the three garrisons of Malan, Taiping, and Yanhe to dispatch one thousand men each year in the fifth month to Miyun; when alarm arises the commander-in-chief shall personally lead reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 居庸、白楊，地要兵弱，遇警必待部奏，不能及事。

translations.literal: Juyong and Baiyang are strategically important but weakly garrisoned; when alarm arises one must wait for a memorial from the ministry and cannot respond in time.
translations.idiomatic: Juyong and Baiyang are strategically vital yet weakly garrisoned; in an emergency one must wait for a ministry memorial and cannot act in time.

sentences.zh: 請預擬借調之法，令建昌三屯軍，平時則協助密雲，遇警則移駐居庸。

translations.literal: I request that a method of advance transfer be prearranged, ordering the three garrisons of Jianchang in peacetime to assist Miyun and in emergency to shift and garrison Juyong.
translations.idiomatic: I request that a method of advance transfer be established, so that the three garrisons of Jianchang assist Miyun in peacetime and shift to garrison Juyong in an emergency.

sentences.zh: 」俱報可。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 久之，宗皋聞敵騎四十萬欲分道入，奏調京營、山東、河南兵為援。

translations.literal: After a long time Zonggao heard that four hundred thousand enemy horsemen intended to enter by separate routes and memorialized to transfer troops from the capital garrison, Shandong, and Henan as reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: After some time Guo Zonggao heard that four hundred thousand enemy horsemen intended to enter by separate routes and memorialized to transfer troops from the capital garrison, Shandong, and Henan as reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 已竟無實，坐奪俸一年。

translations.literal: In the end there proved to be no truth to it; he was punished with one year's salary withheld.
translations.idiomatic: In the end there proved to be no truth to it, and he was punished with one year's salary withheld.

sentences.zh: 故事，京營歲發五軍詣薊鎮防秋。

translations.literal: By precedent the capital garrison each year dispatched five armies to Jizhen for autumn defense.
translations.idiomatic: By established practice the capital garrison dispatched five armies to Jizhen each year for autumn defense.

sentences.zh: 宗皋請罷三軍，以其犒軍銀充本鎮募兵費。

translations.literal: Zonggao requested that three armies be abolished and their troop-reward silver used to fund recruitment in the local command.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Zonggao requested that three armies be abolished and their troop-reward silver used to fund recruitment in the local command.

sentences.zh: 又請發修邊餘銀，增築燕河營、古北口。

translations.literal: He also requested that surplus silver from border repairs be disbursed to expand Yanhe Camp and Gubeikou.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested that surplus silver from border repairs be used to expand Yanhe Camp and Gubeikou.

sentences.zh: 帝疑有侵冒，令罷歸聽勘。

translations.literal: The emperor suspected embezzlement and ordered him dismissed and sent home pending investigation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor suspected embezzlement and ordered him to leave office and return home pending investigation.

sentences.zh: 既而事得白。

translations.literal: Before long the matter was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was cleared of wrongdoing.

sentences.zh: 起故官，巡撫大同，與宣府巡撫李仁易鎮。

translations.literal: He was recalled to his former post, appointed grand coordinator of Datong, and exchanged posts with Grand Coordinator of Xuanfu Li Ren.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to his former rank, appointed grand coordinator of Datong, and exchanged posts with Grand Coordinator of Xuanfu Li Ren.

sentences.zh: 尋進兵部右侍郎，總督宣、大、山西軍務。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of War and given overall military affairs in Xuan, Da, and Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of War and given overall military affairs in Xuanfu, Datong, and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 俺答三萬騎犯萬全左衛，總兵官陳鳳、副總兵林椿與戰鷂兒嶺，殺傷相當，宗皋坐奪俸。

translations.literal: Altan with thirty thousand mounted raiders invaded Wanquan Left Guard; Commanders-in-Chief Chen Feng and Vice Commander Lin Chun fought them at Yao'er Ridge with roughly equal casualties; Zonggao was punished with salary withheld.
translations.idiomatic: Altan with thirty thousand mounted raiders invaded Wanquan Left Guard; Commanders-in-Chief Chen Feng and Vice Commander Lin Chun fought them at Yao'er Ridge with roughly equal casualties, and Guo Zonggao was punished with salary withheld.

sentences.zh: 明年再犯大同，總兵官張達及椿皆戰死，宗皋與巡撫陳燿坐奪俸。

translations.literal: The next year they invaded Datong again; Commanders-in-Chief Zhang Da and Lin Chun both died in battle; Zonggao and Grand Coordinator Chen Yao were punished with salary withheld.
translations.idiomatic: The next year they invaded Datong again; Commanders-in-Chief Zhang Da and Lin Chun both died in battle, and Guo Zonggao and Grand Coordinator Chen Yao were punished with salary withheld.

sentences.zh: 給事中唐禹追論死事狀，因言全軍悉陷，乃數十年未有之大衄。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Tang Yu reviewed the circumstances of the deaths and stated that the entire army had been lost—a major defeat not seen in decades.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Tang Yu reviewed the circumstances of the deaths and argued that the entire army had been lost—the greatest defeat in decades.

sentences.zh: 帝乃逮宗皋及燿，各杖一百，燿遂死，宗皋戍陝西靖虜衛。

translations.literal: The emperor then arrested Zonggao and Yao; each was beaten one hundred strokes; Yao then died; Zonggao was exiled to serve at Jinglu Guard in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then arrested Guo Zonggao and Chen Yao; each was beaten one hundred strokes; Chen Yao then died, and Guo Zonggao was exiled to serve at Jinglu Guard in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 隆慶改元，從戍所起刑部右侍郎，改兵部，協理戎政。

translations.literal: When the Longqing reign began, he was recalled from exile as Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of Justice, transferred to the Ministry of War, and given charge of military administration.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Longqing reign he was recalled from exile as Vice Minister of the Right in the Ministry of Justice, transferred to the Ministry of War, and put in charge of military administration.

sentences.zh: 旋進南京右都御史，就改兵部尚書參贊機務。

translations.literal: Soon he was promoted to Censor-in-Chief of the Right at Nanjing and then changed to Minister of War with concurrent duties assisting in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted to Censor-in-Chief of the Right at Nanjing and then reassigned as Minister of War with concurrent duties assisting in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 給事中莊國禎劾宗皋衰庸，宗皋亦自以年老求去，詔許之。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Zhuang Guozhen impeached Zonggao as decrepit and incompetent; Zonggao also, considering himself old, requested retirement; an edict granted it.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Zhuang Guozhen impeached Guo Zonggao as decrepit and incompetent; Guo Zonggao also, considering himself old, requested retirement, and an edict granted it.

sentences.zh: 萬曆中，再存問，歲給廩隸。

translations.literal: During the Wanli reign he was twice sent greetings of inquiry and granted an annual stipend and attendants.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wanli reign he was twice sent imperial greetings and granted an annual stipend and attendants.

sentences.zh: 十六年，宗皋年九十，又遣行人存問。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Zonggao was ninety; an attendant was again dispatched to inquire after him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Guo Zonggao was ninety, and an attendant was again dispatched to inquire after him.

sentences.zh: 是年卒。

translations.literal: That year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died that year.

sentences.zh: 贈太子太保，諡康介。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous title Kangjie.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous title Kangjie.

sentences.zh: 趙時春，字景仁，平涼人。

translations.literal: Zhao Shichun, styled Jingren, was a man of Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shichun, styled Jingren, was a native of Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 幼與群兒嬉，輒列旗幟，部勒如兵法。

translations.literal: As a child playing with other boys, he would always set out banners and flags and drill them according to military methods.
translations.idiomatic: Even as a child at play with other boys, he would set out banners and flags and drill them as if by military rule.

sentences.zh: 年十四舉於鄉。

translations.literal: At fourteen he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: At the age of fourteen he passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 逾四年，為嘉靖五年，會試第一。

translations.literal: Four years later, in the fifth year of Jiajing, he ranked first in the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: Four years later, in the fifth year of the Jiajing reign, he ranked first in the metropolitan examination.

sentences.zh: 選庶起士。

translations.literal: He was selected as a Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: He was chosen as a Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 以張璁言改官，得戶部主事。

translations.literal: On Zhang Cong's recommendation his appointment was changed, and he received a post as principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On Zhang Cong's recommendation his appointment was changed, and he became a principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 尋轉兵部。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，上疏曰：「陛下以災變求言已旬月，大小臣工率浮詞面謾。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year he submitted a memorial saying: "Your Majesty has sought counsel on account of calamities and portents for a full month, yet officials great and small mostly offer empty words and face-to-face deceit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year he submitted a memorial saying: "Your Majesty has sought counsel on account of calamities and portents for a full month, yet officials great and small mostly offer empty words and deceit to your face.

sentences.zh: 蓋自靈寶知縣言河清受賞，都御史汪鋐繼進甘露，今副都御史徐贊、訓導范仲斌進瑞麥，指揮張楫進嘉禾，鋐及御史楊東又進鹽華，禮部尚書李時再請表賀。

translations.literal: Since the magistrate of Lingbao spoke of the river clearing and received reward, Censor-in-Chief Wang Hong successively presented sweet dew; now Vice Censor-in-Chief Xu Zan and Instructor Fan Zhongbin presented auspicious wheat, Commander Zhang Ji presented fine grain, Hong and Censor Yang Dong again presented salt flowers, and Minister of Rites Li Shi again requested a congratulatory memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Since the magistrate of Lingbao spoke of the river clearing and received a reward, Censor-in-Chief Wang Hong successively presented sweet dew; now Vice Censor-in-Chief Xu Zan and Instructor Fan Zhongbin have presented auspicious wheat, Commander Zhang Ji has presented fine grain, Wang Hong and Censor Yang Dong have again presented salt flowers, and Minister of Rites Li Shi has again requested a congratulatory memorial.

sentences.zh: 仲斌等不足道，鋐、贊司風紀，時典三禮，乃罔上欺君，壞風傷政。

translations.literal: Zhongbin and the like are not worth mentioning, but Hong and Zan oversee censorial discipline and Shi presides over the three ritual codes—yet they deceive the ruler above and harm customs and government.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhongbin and the like are not worth mentioning, but Wang Hong and Xu Zan oversee censorial discipline and Li Shi presides over the three ritual codes—yet they deceive the ruler above and harm customs and government.

sentences.zh: 」帝責其妄言，且令獻讜言善策。

translations.literal: " The emperor rebuked him for reckless speech and also ordered him to submit loyal counsel and good policies.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked him for reckless speech and ordered him to submit loyal counsel and sound policies.

sentences.zh: 時春惶恐引咎未對。

translations.literal: Shichun, in fear and self-reproach, had not yet replied.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shichun, in fear and self-reproach, had not yet replied.

sentences.zh: 帝趣之，於是時春上言：

translations.literal: The emperor pressed him, and thereupon Shichun submitted his words:
translations.idiomatic: The emperor pressed him, and thereupon Zhao Shichun submitted his words:

sentences.zh: 當今之務最大者有四，最急者有三。

translations.literal: Among present tasks the greatest number four, the most urgent three.
translations.idiomatic: Among the tasks of the present day, the greatest number four, and the most urgent three.

sentences.zh: 最大者，曰崇治本。

translations.literal: Of the greatest: first, honor the root of governance.
translations.idiomatic: Of the greatest matters: first, honor the root of governance.

sentences.zh: 君之喜怒，賞罰所自出，勿以逆心事為可怒，則賞罰大公而天下治。

translations.literal: The ruler's joy and anger are the source from which rewards and punishments proceed; do not treat unwelcome matters as grounds for anger, then rewards and punishments will be broadly fair and the realm will be governed.
translations.idiomatic: The ruler's joy and anger are the source from which rewards and punishments proceed; do not treat unwelcome matters as grounds for anger, and rewards and punishments will be broadly fair and the realm will be well governed.

sentences.zh: 曰信號令。

translations.literal: Second, trust in commands and edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Second, have faith in commands and edicts.

sentences.zh: 無信一人之言，必參諸公論；

translations.literal: Do not trust the words of one person alone; they must be weighed against public opinion;
translations.idiomatic: Do not trust the word of a single person; it must be weighed against public opinion;

sentences.zh: 毋狃一時之近，必稽之永遠。

translations.literal: do not cling to what is near in the moment; one must examine it in light of the long term.
translations.idiomatic: do not cling to what is immediately at hand; it must be examined in light of the long term.

sentences.zh: 苟利十而害一，則利不必興；

translations.literal: If there is ten parts benefit and one part harm, then the benefit need not be pursued;
translations.idiomatic: If benefit is ten and harm one, the benefit need not be pursued;

sentences.zh: 功百而費半，則功不必舉。

translations.literal: if the achievement is a hundred but the cost half, then the achievement need not be undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: if achievement is a hundred and cost half, the achievement need not be undertaken.

sentences.zh: 如是而天下享安靜之福矣。

translations.literal: In this way the realm will enjoy the blessing of peace and quiet.
translations.idiomatic: Then the realm will enjoy the blessing of peace and quiet.

sentences.zh: 曰廣延訪。

translations.literal: Third, broadly extend consultation.
translations.idiomatic: Third, extend consultation broadly.

sentences.zh: 宜仿古人輪對及我朝宣召之制，使大臣、台諫、侍從各得敷納殿陛間，群吏則以其職事召問之。

translations.literal: One ought to follow the ancient system of rotating audience and our dynasty's system of imperial summons, so that great ministers, censorial and remonstrance officials, and attendants may each expound and offer counsel in the hall, while the various officials are summoned and questioned according to their duties.
translations.idiomatic: One ought to follow the ancient system of rotating audience and our dynasty's system of imperial summons, so that senior ministers, censorial and remonstrance officials, and attendants may each expound and offer counsel in the imperial hall, while the various officials are summoned and questioned according to their duties.

sentences.zh: 曰勵廉恥。

translations.literal: Fourth, encourage integrity and shame.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, encourage integrity and a sense of shame.

sentences.zh: 大臣宜待以禮，取大節略小過。

translations.literal: Great ministers should be treated with ritual propriety, taking their great integrity and overlooking minor faults.
translations.idiomatic: Great ministers should be treated with ritual propriety, honoring their essential integrity while overlooking minor faults.

sentences.zh: 台諫言是者用之，非者寬容之。

translations.literal: When censors and remonstrators speak what is right, employ them; when not, be tolerant.
translations.idiomatic: When censors and remonstrators speak what is right, employ their counsel; when they do not, be tolerant.

sentences.zh: 庶臣工自愛，不敢不勵。

translations.literal: Thus officials will cherish themselves and not dare fail to exert themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In this way officials will value their standing and not dare fail to exert themselves.

sentences.zh: 其最急者，曰惜人才。

translations.literal: Among the most urgent matters: cherish human talent.
translations.idiomatic: Among the most urgent matters is this: cherish human talent.

sentences.zh: 凡得罪諸臣，其才不當棄，其過或可原，宜霈然發命，召還故秩。

translations.literal: For all ministers who have offended, their talent should not be cast away; their faults may be pardoned; a broad edict should be issued summoning them back to their former ranks.
translations.idiomatic: For all ministers who have offended, their talent should not be discarded and their faults may be forgiven; a broad edict should summon them back to their former ranks.

sentences.zh: 且因南郊禮成，除謫戍之罪，與之更始。

translations.literal: Moreover, when the southern suburban rites are completed, remit the crimes of those banished to frontier garrison duty and give them a fresh start.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when the southern suburban rites are completed, remit the crimes of those banished to frontier garrison duty and give them a fresh start.

sentences.zh: 曰固邊圉。

translations.literal: Next: secure the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Next: secure the frontier.

sentences.zh: 敗軍之律宜嚴，臨陣而退者，裨將得以戮士卒，大將得以戮裨將，總制官得以戮大將，則人心震悚，而所向用命。

translations.literal: The laws for defeated armies should be strict: for those who retreat in battle, assistant generals may execute soldiers, generals may execute assistant generals, and supreme commanders may execute generals—then hearts will be awed and orders obeyed in action.
translations.idiomatic: The laws governing defeated armies should be strict: when men retreat in battle, assistant generals may execute soldiers, generals may execute assistant generals, and supreme commanders may execute generals—then hearts will be awed and troops will obey in action.

sentences.zh: 曰正治教。

translations.literal: Next: rectify governance and instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Next: rectify governance and instruction.

sentences.zh: 請復古冠婚、喪祭之禮，絕醮祭、禱祀之術。

translations.literal: Please restore the ancient rites of capping, marriage, mourning, and sacrifice, and abolish Daoist offerings and prayer rituals.
translations.idiomatic: Please restore the ancient rites of capping, marriage, mourning, and sacrifice, and abolish Daoist offerings and prayer rituals.

sentences.zh: 凡佛老之徒有假引符籙、依託經懺、幻化黃白、飛升遐景以冒寵祿者，即賜遣斥，則正道修明而民志定。

translations.literal: All followers of Buddhism and Daoism who falsely cite talismans, rely on scripture recitation, conjure gold and silver, or claim ascension to distant realms to usurp favor and salary should at once be dismissed and expelled; then the orthodox Way will be cultivated and the people's will settled.
translations.idiomatic: All followers of Buddhism and Daoism who falsely cite talismans, rely on scripture recitation, conjure gold and silver, or claim ascension to distant realms in order to usurp favor and salary should at once be dismissed and expelled; then the orthodox Way will be cultivated and the people's will settled.

sentences.zh: 帝覽之，益怒，下詔獄掠治，黜為民。

translations.literal: The Emperor read it, grew still angrier, had him thrown into the imperial prison and tortured under interrogation, and reduced him to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor read it, grew still angrier, had him thrown into the imperial prison and tortured under interrogation, and reduced him to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 久之，選東宮官屬，起翰林編修兼司經局校書。

translations.literal: After a long while, when selecting Eastern Palace staff, he was raised as Hanlin Compiler and concurrently proofreader in the Classics Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while, when selecting Eastern Palace staff, he was raised as Hanlin compiler and concurrently proofreader in the Classics Bureau.

sentences.zh: 帝有疾，時春與羅洪先、唐順之疏請東宮禦殿，受百官正旦朝賀。

translations.literal: When the Emperor fell ill, Shichun together with Luo Hongxian and Tang Shunzhi memorialized requesting that the Eastern Palace preside in the hall and receive the New Year's court congratulations of all officials.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor fell ill, Shichun together with Luo Hongxian and Tang Shunzhi memorialized requesting that the heir apparent preside in the hall and receive the New Year's court congratulations of all officials.

sentences.zh: 帝大怒，復黜為民。

translations.literal: The Emperor was greatly enraged and again reduced him to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly enraged and again reduced him to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 京師被寇，朝議以時春知兵，起兵部主事，贊理京營務，統民兵訓練。

translations.literal: When the capital was raided, court opinion held that Shichun understood military affairs; he was raised to principal clerk in the Ministry of War, assisted in managing capital garrison affairs, and commanded militia training.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital was raided, the court held that Shichun understood military affairs; he was raised to principal clerk in the Ministry of War, assisted in managing capital garrison affairs, and commanded militia training.

sentences.zh: 大將軍仇鸞倡馬市，時春憤曰：「此秦檜續耳。

translations.literal: Grand General Qiu Luan advocated the horse markets; Shichun said in anger, "This is but a continuation of Qin Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Grand general Qiu Luan advocated the horse markets; Shichun said in anger, "This is but a continuation of Qin Hui.

sentences.zh: 身為大將，而效市儈，可乎？

translations.literal: To be a great general and yet act like a market peddler—can that be right?
translations.idiomatic: To be a great general and yet act like a market peddler—can that be right?

sentences.zh: 」忤鸞，為所構，幾重得罪。

translations.literal: " He offended Luan, was framed by him, and nearly suffered heavy punishment.
translations.idiomatic: " He offended Luan, was framed by him, and nearly suffered heavy punishment.

sentences.zh: 稍遷山東僉事，進副使。

translations.literal: He was gradually transferred to surveillance commissioner of Shandong and advanced to vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was gradually transferred to surveillance commissioner of Shandong and advanced to vice commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，擢僉都御史，巡撫山西。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief and appointed grand coordinator of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he was promoted to vice censor-in-chief and appointed grand coordinator of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 時春慷慨負奇氣，善騎射。

translations.literal: Shichun was generous and possessed an extraordinary spirit; he was skilled in horsemanship and archery.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun was generous and possessed an extraordinary spirit; he was skilled in horsemanship and archery.

sentences.zh: 慨寇縱橫，將帥不任職，數謂人：「使吾領選卒五千，俺答、邱福不足平也。

translations.literal: Lamenting that bandits ranged freely and generals failed in their duties, he often told people, "If I were given command of five thousand picked troops, Altan and Qiu Fu would be nothing to pacify.
translations.idiomatic: Lamenting that raiders ranged freely and generals failed in their duties, he often told people, "If I were given command of five thousand picked troops, Altan and Qiu Fu would be nothing to pacify.

sentences.zh: 」作《禦寇論》，論戰守甚悉。

translations.literal: " He wrote the Treatise on Repelling Bandits, discussing offense and defense in great detail.
translations.idiomatic: " He wrote the Treatise on Repelling Bandits, discussing offense and defense in great detail.

sentences.zh: 既秉節鉞，益思以武功自奮。

translations.literal: Once he held the commander's tally, he thought all the more to distinguish himself by military achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Once he held the commander's tally, he thought all the more to distinguish himself by military achievement.

sentences.zh: 其年九月，寇入神池、利民諸堡，時春率馬步兵往禦之。

translations.literal: That year in the ninth month, raiders entered the forts of Shenchi, Limin, and others; Shichun led cavalry and infantry to repel them.
translations.idiomatic: That year in the ninth month, raiders entered the forts of Shenchi, Limin, and others; Shichun led cavalry and infantry to repel them.

sentences.zh: 至廣武，諸將畢會。

translations.literal: At Guangwu all the generals assembled.
translations.idiomatic: At Guangwu all the generals assembled.

sentences.zh: 謀報寇騎二千餘，去兩舍。

translations.literal: Scouts reported more than two thousand enemy horsemen, two stages away.
translations.idiomatic: Scouts reported more than two thousand enemy horsemen, two stages away.

sentences.zh: 時春擐甲欲馳，大將李淶固止之。

translations.literal: Shichun donned armor and wished to charge; General Li Qing firmly stopped him.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun donned armor and wished to charge; general Li Qing firmly stopped him.

sentences.zh: 時春大言曰：「賊知吾來必遁，緩追即不及。

translations.literal: Shichun spoke loudly, "When the bandits know I have come they will surely flee; if we delay pursuit we will not catch them.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun spoke loudly, "When the bandits know I have come they will surely flee; if we delay pursuit we will not catch them.

sentences.zh: 」遂策馬前。

translations.literal: " He then spurred his horse forward.
translations.idiomatic: " He then spurred his horse forward.

sentences.zh: 及於大蟲嶺，伏兵四起，敗績。

translations.literal: At Dachong Ridge ambush troops rose on every side and he suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: At Dachong Ridge ambush troops rose on every side and he suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 倉皇投一墩，守卒縋之上乃得免，淶軍竟覆。

translations.literal: In panic he fled to a beacon tower; the garrison soldiers hauled him up by rope before he escaped, while Qing's army was utterly destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In panic he fled to a beacon tower; the garrison soldiers hauled him up by rope before he escaped, while Qing's army was utterly destroyed.

sentences.zh: 被論，解官聽調。

translations.literal: He was impeached, stripped of office, and held awaiting reassignment.
translations.idiomatic: He was impeached, stripped of office, and held awaiting reassignment.

sentences.zh: 時春喜談兵，至是一戰而敗。

translations.literal: Shichun loved to discuss military affairs; now one battle brought defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun loved to discuss military affairs; now one battle brought defeat.

sentences.zh: 然當是時將帥率避寇不擊。

translations.literal: Yet at that time generals generally avoided the bandits and would not attack.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at that time generals generally avoided the raiders and would not attack.

sentences.zh: 為督撫者安居堅城，遙領軍事，無躬搏寇者。

translations.literal: Those serving as supreme commanders and grand coordinators dwelt secure in strong cities, directed military affairs from afar, and none personally grappled with the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Those serving as supreme commanders and grand coordinators dwelt secure in strong cities, directed military affairs from afar, and none personally grappled with the enemy.

sentences.zh: 時春功雖不就，天下皆壯其氣。

translations.literal: Though Shichun's achievement did not succeed, all under Heaven admired his spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Though Shichun's achievement did not succeed, all under Heaven admired his spirit.

sentences.zh: 時春讀書善強記，文章豪肆，與唐順之、王慎中齊名。

translations.literal: Shichun in reading had a strong memory; his essays were bold and expansive, and he was famed alongside Tang Shunzhi and Wang Shenzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Shichun had a strong memory in reading; his essays were bold and expansive, and he was famed alongside Tang Shunzhi and Wang Shenzhong.

sentences.zh: 詩，伉浪自喜類其為人。

translations.literal: In poetry he was proud and unrestrained, pleased with himself in a manner like his character.
translations.idiomatic: In poetry he was proud and unrestrained, pleased with himself in a manner that matched his character.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：姚鏌等封疆宣其擘畫，軍務暢其機謀，勳績咸有可紀。

translations.literal: The eulogy says: Yao Mo and the others in frontier administration proclaimed their planning, in military affairs their stratagems flowed freely, and their achievements are all worth recording.
translations.idiomatic: The eulogy says: Yao Mo and the others in frontier administration proclaimed their planning, in military affairs their stratagems flowed freely, and their achievements are all worth recording.

sentences.zh: 伍文定從王守仁平宸濠之難，厥功最懋。

translations.literal: Wu Wending followed Wang Shouren in pacifying the crisis of Chen Hao; his merit was the greatest.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Wending followed Wang Shouren in pacifying the crisis of Chen Hao; his merit was the greatest.

sentences.zh: 趙時春將略自命，一出輒躓。

translations.literal: Zhao Shichun styled himself a strategist; once he went forth he stumbled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shichun styled himself a strategist; once he went forth he stumbled.

sentences.zh: 夫危事而易言之，固知兵者所弗取乎。

translations.literal: To speak lightly of perilous affairs—surely those who understand warfare will not approve of that.
translations.idiomatic: To speak lightly of perilous affairs—surely those who understand warfare will not approve of that.
